naming.scope: 机制名「animation-delay:180ms」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 经典三点但节奏要慢
definition.en: The three dots, but slower

distinction.zh: 间隔 180ms、幅度 3px，快了就显焦虑。
distinction.en: 180ms apart, 3px travel — faster reads as anxious.

naming.scope: 机制名「details」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 过程默认收起，想看再展开
definition.en: Reasoning stays folded until asked

distinction.zh: 摘要一行 + 展开显示步骤，别默认铺开一屏。
distinction.en: One summary line; expand for the steps.

naming.scope: 机制名「opacity:0.6」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 过程用更淡的字滚动
definition.en: The process scrolls in dimmer type

distinction.zh: 推理区用 85% 字号、60% 不透明度，与结论区分开。
distinction.en: Dim and shrink the trace so the answer still leads.

naming.scope: 机制名「details:open」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 它正在用哪个工具、传了什么
definition.en: Which tool, with what arguments

distinction.zh: 工具名 + 参数摘要 + 状态点，参数默认折叠。
distinction.en: Tool name, argument summary, status dot; args folded by default.

naming.scope: 机制名「aria-busy」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 这一步还在跑
definition.en: This step is still running

distinction.zh: 状态点用脉冲不用转圈，超过 10s 才给进度。
distinction.en: A pulsing dot, not a spinner; add progress past ten seconds.

naming.scope: 机制名「log」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 跑完了变成一条静态记录
definition.en: It settles into a record

distinction.zh: 完成时收起动效、换静态勾选，别继续闪。
distinction.en: Kill the motion on completion and show a static check.

naming.scope: 机制名「aria-describedby」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 失败要能看懂并能重试
definition.en: Failure must be readable and retryable

distinction.zh: 错误摘要 + 原始输出可展开 + 一个重试按钮。
distinction.en: Summary, expandable raw output, one retry.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（约定：先报总步数再逐条勾掉、步数不偷改，属流程约束，没有机制名。）

definition.zh: 先说要做几步，再一步步勾掉
definition.en: It states the steps, then ticks them off

distinction.zh: 步骤数固定后别偷偷改；新增步骤要有插入动效。
distinction.en: Do not silently mutate the plan — animate insertions.

naming.scope: 机制名「aria-current」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 当前步高亮，已完成变灰
definition.en: Current step leads, done steps recede

distinction.zh: 只强调当前一步；完成的降到 60% 不透明度。
distinction.en: Emphasise one step; fade the finished ones.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：主线竖线 + 子任务向右分叉再收回的连线布局，属可视化表达，无标准机制。）

definition.zh: 派出去几个并行干
definition.en: It forks into parallel workers

distinction.zh: 主线一条竖线，子任务向右分叉再收回。
distinction.en: One spine with branches that fork right and rejoin.

naming.scope: 机制名「transition:opacity 200ms」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 换一个 agent 接手
definition.en: A different agent takes over

distinction.zh: 头像/名字交叉淡入 200ms，历史保留在同一条流里。
distinction.en: Cross-fade the identity in 200ms; keep one thread.

naming.scope: 机制名「alertdialog」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 危险动作先问一句
definition.en: Destructive actions ask first

distinction.zh: 确认卡里写清副作用范围，主按钮不要默认聚焦。
distinction.en: Spell out the blast radius; do not autofocus confirm.

naming.scope: 机制名「del」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 动手之前先给你看 diff
definition.en: See the diff before it lands

distinction.zh: 增删用背景色 + 前缀符号双编码，可逐块接受。
distinction.en: Colour plus sign prefix, accepted hunk by hunk.

naming.scope: 机制名「Stop generating」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 任何时候都能叫停
definition.en: You can always stop it

distinction.zh: 生成中主按钮变成"停止"，别藏在菜单里。
distinction.en: The primary button becomes Stop — never hide it in a menu.

naming.scope: 机制名「AbortController.abort()」（platform 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 中途插一句就改方向
definition.en: You can steer mid-run

distinction.zh: 打断后保留已完成部分，新指令作为补充上下文。
distinction.en: Keep completed work; treat the interjection as added context.

naming.scope: 机制名「sup」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 每句话都能点回原文
definition.en: Every claim links back

distinction.zh: 上标数字 + 悬停显示片段，别只在末尾堆链接。
distinction.en: Superscript markers with hover previews, not a link dump.

naming.scope: 机制名「mark」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 悬停引用时原文亮起来
definition.en: Hovering a citation lights the source

distinction.zh: 双向联动：正文与来源互相高亮，色相一致。
distinction.en: Two-way highlight with one shared hue.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（文案：用文字与区间表达不确定、拒绝假精度，属措辞策略；与 ai/confidence 的三档写法同源，但是否合并待独立判断。）

definition.zh: 不确定就说不确定
definition.en: Say so when it is unsure

distinction.zh: 用文字与区间，别用百分比装精确。
distinction.en: Words and ranges beat fake precision.

naming.scope: 机制名「Element.scrollIntoView()」（platform 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 答案旁边就是原文
definition.en: The source sits beside the answer

distinction.zh: 点引用滚动侧栏到对应段落，不要新开页。
distinction.en: Scroll the panel to the passage; never open a new page.

naming.scope: 机制名「Chip」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 它现在看得见哪些东西
definition.en: What it can currently see

distinction.zh: 每个附件/文件一个可删除的 pill，超出折叠成 +N。
distinction.en: One removable pill per attachment, overflow as +N.

naming.scope: 机制名「meter」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 还剩多少窗口
definition.en: How much window is left

distinction.zh: 接近上限才出现并变色，平时不打扰。
distinction.en: Only appears near the limit.

naming.scope: 机制名「Snackbar」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 它记住了一件事，要让你知道
definition.en: It remembered something — tell the user

distinction.zh: 写入时给一条可撤销的轻提示，别静默。
distinction.en: A dismissible, undoable toast — never silent.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（约定：记忆条目带来源、时间、可删除，属列表项的组合约定。）

definition.zh: 记住的东西可查可删
definition.en: Memories are visible and removable

distinction.zh: 每条带来源与时间，删除立即生效。
distinction.en: Show origin and time; deletion is immediate.

naming.scope: 机制名「alertdialog」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一次授权到什么边界
definition.en: The exact boundary of consent

distinction.zh: 按资源与动作分开授权，默认最小权限。
distinction.en: Scope by resource and verb; default to least privilege.

naming.scope: 机制名「radiogroup」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 从"每步都问"到"放手跑"
definition.en: From ask-every-step to full auto

distinction.zh: 三档就够：建议 / 确认后执行 / 自动执行。
distinction.en: Three levels: suggest, confirm, auto.

naming.scope: 机制名「Waterfall」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 整段任务的时间轴
definition.en: The whole run on one axis

distinction.zh: 每步一条，宽度=耗时，慢的那步一眼看到。
distinction.en: Bar width equals duration; the slow step stands out.

naming.scope: 机制名「tree」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 谁调了谁，一眼看清
definition.en: Who called what

distinction.zh: 缩进 + 耗时条，超时的分支自动展开。
distinction.en: Indent plus duration; auto-expand the slow branch.

naming.scope: 机制名「font-feature-settings:tnum」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 这次跑了多少钱
definition.en: What this run cost

distinction.zh: 实时累加但低调，结束后给一条汇总。
distinction.en: Accumulate quietly, summarise at the end.

naming.scope: 机制名「timer」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 告诉我大概还要多久
definition.en: Say roughly how long

distinction.zh: 超过 2s 给预估，超过 10s 给可离开提示。
distinction.en: Estimate past 2s; offer to notify past 10s.

naming.scope: 机制名「aria-busy」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 先给结构再填内容
definition.en: Structure first, content after

distinction.zh: 骨架形状要贴近真实答案的段落结构。
distinction.en: Shape the skeleton like the real answer.

naming.scope: 机制名「Progressive disclosure」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 先结论，再细节，再证据
definition.en: Answer, then detail, then evidence

distinction.zh: 三层结构：一句话 / 要点 / 原始材料。
distinction.en: Three tiers: sentence, bullets, raw material.

naming.scope: 机制名「aria-autocomplete」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 灰字建议，Tab 接受
definition.en: Ghost text, Tab to accept

distinction.zh: 建议用 45% 灰、不换行，Esc 立即撤。
distinction.en: Ghost text at 45% grey, Esc dismisses instantly.

naming.scope: 机制名「transition:color 120ms」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 接受时灰字变实
definition.en: Ghost text turns solid

distinction.zh: 120ms 变色不移位，光标跳到末尾。
distinction.en: 120ms colour change, no reflow, caret to the end.

naming.scope: 机制名「aria-activedescendant」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 打 / 就出命令表
definition.en: Slash opens the command list

distinction.zh: 模糊匹配 + 键盘优先，第一项默认高亮。
distinction.en: Fuzzy match, keyboard first, first item preselected.

naming.scope: 机制名「listbox」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: @ 一下把东西塞进上下文
definition.en: Mention to attach context

distinction.zh: 分组显示（文件/人/工具），最近使用置顶。
distinction.en: Group by kind with recents first.

naming.scope: 机制名「Split view」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 答案落在一块可编辑的画布上
definition.en: The answer lands on an editable canvas

distinction.zh: 左侧对话、右侧文档，改动实时打点。
distinction.en: Chat left, artefact right, edits marked live.

naming.scope: 机制名「Version history」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 每次修改都留一版
definition.en: Every revision is kept

distinction.zh: 版本条可左右翻，diff 可开关。
distinction.en: A version rail with a diff toggle.

naming.scope: 机制名「table-layout:fixed」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 表格一行行长出来
definition.en: Rows arrive one at a time

distinction.zh: 表头先定列宽，后续行不许改列宽。
distinction.en: Lock the column widths on the header row.

naming.scope: 机制名「pre」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 代码一边写一边高亮
definition.en: Code highlights as it streams

distinction.zh: 未闭合的块先按纯文本渲染，闭合后再上色。
distinction.en: Render unclosed blocks as plain text, colour on close.

naming.scope: 机制名「output」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 答案里的代码能直接跑
definition.en: The code in the answer runs

distinction.zh: 运行状态三态：待运行 / 运行中 / 有输出。
distinction.en: Three states: idle, running, has output.

naming.scope: 机制名「transition:transform」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 它在界面上自己动手
definition.en: It moves the pointer itself

distinction.zh: 带名字标签的光标，动作前先移动过去让人跟得上。
distinction.en: A labelled cursor that travels before it acts.

naming.scope: 机制名「outline-offset」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 它要点哪里就先圈出来
definition.en: It rings the target before clicking

distinction.zh: 目标周围一圈脉冲，250ms 后才真的点。
distinction.en: Pulse the target, then click 250ms later.

naming.scope: 机制名「figure」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 它在看哪一页
definition.en: Which page it is reading

distinction.zh: 域名 + 标题 + 缩略截图，一步一条。
distinction.en: Domain, title and a thumbnail per step.

naming.scope: 机制名「Diff view」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 哪些文件被改了
definition.en: Which files changed

distinction.zh: 路径 + 增删行数，点开是 diff。
distinction.en: Path plus line delta, expanding into a diff.

naming.scope: 机制名「Notification API」（platform 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 跑太久就让你先去干别的
definition.en: It tells you to go do something else

distinction.zh: 超过 60s 提供"完成后通知我"，标签页标题带角标。
distinction.en: Offer notify-on-done past 60s and badge the tab title.

naming.scope: 机制名「draggable」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 排着队的任务也要可见
definition.en: Queued work stays visible

distinction.zh: 队列显示位次与预计开始，可拖拽改序。
distinction.en: Show position and ETA; allow reordering.

naming.scope: 机制名「progress」（html 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 同时在跑好几件事
definition.en: Several things at once

distinction.zh: 每个任务一行进度，别用一个总进度糊过去。
distinction.en: One row per task — not a single fake total.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（数据策略：按一次运行分组整体回滚而不是逐条 undo，属回退策略，无唯一界面机制。）

definition.zh: 做错了要能整段撤回
definition.en: A wrong run can be undone whole

distinction.zh: 按运行分组撤销，不是一步步 undo。
distinction.en: Undo by run, not step by step.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（约定：通过/未通过徽章 + 可展开细则的组合，等于通用 Badge 叠 details，无独立机制名。）

definition.zh: 这条回答被验证过
definition.en: This answer was checked

distinction.zh: 通过/未通过 + 检查项数量，可展开看细则。
distinction.en: Pass state plus check count, expandable.

naming.scope: 机制名「alert」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 被拦下来要说清为什么
definition.en: A refusal must explain itself

distinction.zh: 给原因、给边界、给可行的替代路径。
distinction.en: Reason, boundary, and an alternative.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（约定：环境标识常驻 + 生产环境换一种配色的视觉规范。）

definition.zh: 它现在跑在隔离环境里
definition.en: It is running sandboxed

distinction.zh: 环境标识常驻，生产环境要用另一种颜色。
distinction.en: Keep the environment badge pinned; production gets its own colour.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（阈值：80% 提醒、100% 暂停并等确认的预算阈值逻辑，属规则而非机制。）

definition.zh: 快超预算就先停下问
definition.en: It stops before overspending

distinction.zh: 达到 80% 提醒，100% 暂停并等确认。
distinction.en: Warn at 80%, pause at 100%.

naming.scope: 机制名「aria-pressed」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 好不好用一秒能说
definition.en: One second to say if it worked

distinction.zh: 两个图标 + 可选原因标签，别弹问卷。
distinction.en: Two icons and optional reason tags — never a survey.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（约定：保留上一版并横向对比而不是覆盖，属对比式重试的交互约定（与 ai/regenerate 的版本切换不是同一件事）。）

definition.zh: 再来一版并能对比
definition.en: Another take, side by side

distinction.zh: 保留上一版，横向对比而不是覆盖。
distinction.en: Keep the last one and compare — do not overwrite.

naming.scope: 机制名「Suggestion chip」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 给三个下一步问法
definition.en: Three ways to keep going

distinction.zh: 最多三条、都短，点了就填进输入框。
distinction.en: Three short chips that fill the composer.

naming.scope: 机制名「HTML Drag and Drop API」（platform 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 拖张图进去就能问
definition.en: Drop an image and ask

distinction.zh: 拖入时整个输入区变成投放目标并说明支持格式。
distinction.en: The whole composer becomes the drop target.

agent/multimodaldrop.reference: 「HTML Drag and Drop API」的「多模态投喂」

naming.scope: 机制名「AnalyserNode」（platform 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一个球表示在听/在说
definition.en: One orb: listening or speaking

distinction.zh: 听时随音量起伏，说时匀速呼吸，两种节奏要分得开。
distinction.en: Amplitude-reactive while listening, steady while speaking.

naming.scope: 机制名「align-self」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 谁在说话要一眼看出
definition.en: Who has the floor

distinction.zh: 双方用不同对齐与底色，别只靠头像。
distinction.en: Different alignment and fill, not just avatars.

naming.scope: 机制名「aria-live」（aria 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 它先想到了，但不打断你
definition.en: It offers without interrupting

distinction.zh: 角落轻提示，3 秒不理就自己收起。
distinction.en: A corner hint that retires after three seconds.

naming.scope: 机制名「box-shadow:0 0 0 2px」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 同一个头像表达四种状态
definition.en: One avatar, four states

distinction.zh: 空闲/思考/执行/出错，用环而不是换图。
distinction.en: Idle, thinking, acting, error — as a ring, not a new image.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（约定：可暂停、可筛选、可复制复现脚本的事件流面板，属通用日志视图组合。）

definition.zh: 开发者要能看到全部原始事件
definition.en: Raw events for the operator

distinction.zh: 事件流可暂停、可筛选、可复制为可复现脚本。
distinction.en: Pausable, filterable, copyable as a repro script.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：一路删减到必需项，取舍原则而非某一机制。）

definition.zh: 把东西拿掉，直到只剩必须的那一句
definition.en: Remove until only the necessary sentence is left

distinction.zh: 一个视觉焦点、一种字体两个字重、大面积留白当版面元素用；对比靠字号级差而不是颜色。首屏拒绝把自己填满。
distinction.en: One focal point, one typeface in two weights, white space treated as a component. Contrast comes from scale, not colour — and the hero refuses to fill itself.

naming.scope: 机制名「grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 网格、无衬线、一条红斜线
definition.en: Grid, grotesque, one red rule

distinction.zh: 严格模块网格 + Helvetica 类字体 + 齐左不齐右；单一强调色只出现在一个几何元素上，绝不铺满。
distinction.en: A strict modular grid, a grotesque face, flush-left ragged-right text, and a single accent colour on exactly one geometric element.

naming.scope: 机制名「clip-path:polygon」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 圆方三角与三原色
definition.en: Circle, square, triangle, primaries

distinction.zh: 基本几何形 + 红黄蓝 + 无衬线全大写；形体承担全部装饰，绝不加纹理与阴影。构成要能拆成尺规能画出来的元素。
distinction.en: Primitive geometry, red/yellow/blue, uppercase sans. Form carries all decoration — no texture, no shadow. Everything drawable with compass and rule.

naming.scope: 机制名「font-variant-numeric」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 像一篇论文的图，而不是营销页
definition.en: Figures from a paper, not a marketing page

distinction.zh: 白底细线 + 等宽数字 + 真坐标轴与图例 + 单一强调色；不要渐变、不要入场动画。数字自己会说话。
distinction.en: White ground, hairlines, tabular numerals, real axes and legends, one accent. No gradients, no entrance animation — the numbers carry it.

naming.scope: 机制名「background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 像一张施工图
definition.en: Reads like a construction drawing

distinction.zh: 蓝底白线或白底细蓝线 + 尺寸标注 + 剖面符号 + 等宽标签；线宽严格分级（0.25 / 0.5 / 1pt），标注比图形更重要。
distinction.en: Blue ground with white lines, dimension callouts, section marks, monospace labels. Line weights strictly graded — the annotation matters more than the drawing.

naming.scope: 机制名「Editorial」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 像一本杂志的内页，而不是一个落地页
definition.en: A magazine spread, not a landing page

distinction.zh: 衬线大标题 + 多栏正文 + 图注小字；靠栏宽变化与首字下沉建立阅读节奏，导航退成一行细字。
distinction.en: Serif display, multi-column body, small captions. Rhythm comes from varying measure and a drop cap; the nav shrinks to one thin line.

naming.scope: 机制名「Newspaper」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 报头、栏线、通栏大标题
definition.en: A masthead, column rules, a banner headline

distinction.zh: 衬线报头 + 多栏细分栏线 + 报纸灰纸底 + 图注小字；标题层级用字号跨度而不是颜色，双线分隔是签名动作。
distinction.en: A serif masthead, hairline column rules, newsprint grey, small captions. Hierarchy by size jumps, never colour; the double rule is the signature.

naming.scope: 机制名「Documentation layout」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 产品长得像一份文档
definition.en: The product looks like a document

distinction.zh: 左侧目录 + 单栏正文 + 行内块编辑 + 极浅分隔线；字体层级少，靠间距分节，光标是唯一的动效。
distinction.en: A sidebar outline, one text column, inline blocks, near-invisible rules. Few type levels; spacing does the sectioning and the caret is the only motion.

naming.scope: 机制名「CJK display」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 把汉字当成版面主体，不是英文版式的填空
definition.en: Han characters as the subject, not filler in a Latin layout

distinction.zh: 大字号中文标题 + 字重只用两级 + 行高 1.5 以上 + 标点挤压；英文降为辅助行，字距靠字号而不是 letter-spacing。
distinction.en: Large Han display type, only two weights, line-height above 1.5, punctuation kerned. Latin drops to a support line; rhythm from size, not letter-spacing.

naming.scope: 机制名「background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 近黑的夜空里挂着一颗会呼吸的球
definition.en: A breathing orb hung in a near-black sky

distinction.zh: 近黑冷底 + 一颗大尺寸发光球体（月/星/环）+ 极简中文大字 + 一条细高光；渐变必须细，球体只有一个光源。
distinction.en: A near-black cool ground, one oversized luminous orb, minimal large CJK type, one hairline specular. Faint gradients; the orb takes exactly one light.

naming.scope: 机制名「backdrop-filter:blur(12px)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 半透明面板浮在彩色背景上
definition.en: Frosted panels floating over colour

distinction.zh: backdrop-filter:blur + 8–16% 白底 + 1px 高光描边；必须有彩色或图像背景才成立，且要盯住正文对比度。
distinction.en: backdrop-filter blur, an 8–16% white fill, a 1px light border. It only works over colour or imagery — and body contrast needs watching.

naming.scope: 机制名「box-shadow:inset」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 控件像从同色表面顶出来的
definition.en: Controls extruded from a same-colour surface

distinction.zh: 同色底 + 一对相反方向的柔和内外阴影；对比天生偏低，交互态必须再加边框或色彩兜底，否则不可用。
distinction.en: One surface colour with paired soft light/dark shadows. Contrast is inherently low — back every interaction state with a border or colour or it fails accessibility.

naming.scope: 机制名「box-shadow:0 20px 40px」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一切都像捏出来的软陶
definition.en: Everything looks moulded from clay

distinction.zh: 超大圆角 + 双层柔和内外阴影 + 低饱和粉彩；形体要"胖"，描边为零，投影要软到看不出边界。
distinction.en: Huge radii, layered soft inner and outer shadows, pastel fills. Forms are chubby, strokes are zero, shadows soft enough to have no edge.

naming.scope: 机制名「Skeuomorphism」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 界面模仿真实材质
definition.en: The interface imitates real material

distinction.zh: 材质贴图、缝线、金属高光、真实投影；隐喻必须一致，别一半木纹一半扁平。光源方向全站统一。
distinction.en: Textures, stitching, metal speculars, real shadows. Keep the metaphor consistent — no half wood-grain, half flat — and one light direction site-wide.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：米白灰褐 + 天然材质留痕 + 负空间 + 细字重的组合，无唯一机制。）

definition.zh: 素材本身就是装饰
definition.en: The material is the decoration

distinction.zh: 米白与灰褐 + 天然材质留痕 + 大量负空间 + 细字重；不对称构图，禁止纯黑与高饱和，动效慢到几乎察觉不到。
distinction.en: Off-white and taupe, visible material grain, deep negative space, light weights. Asymmetric; no pure black, no saturation, motion slow to the edge of perception.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：暗底/米底 + 细衬线大写 + 宽字距 + 慢动效 + 描边 CTA 的组合，无唯一机制。）

definition.zh: 克制、高级、留白买不起
definition.en: Restrained, expensive, space you can’t afford

distinction.zh: 暗色或米色底 + 细衬线大写标题 + 宽字距 + 金铜色细节；动效必须慢，任何弹跳都掉价。CTA 只用描边。
distinction.en: Dark or ivory ground, light serif caps, wide tracking, brass details. Motion must be slow — any bounce cheapens it. CTAs are outline only.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：默认字体、纯黑白、无圆角无阴影、超大字号的态度式做法。）

definition.zh: 不修饰，硬碰硬
definition.en: Unfinished on purpose, hard against hard

distinction.zh: 默认字体、纯黑白、无圆角无阴影、超大字号压满版；把 HTML 的结构本身暴露出来当装饰。
distinction.en: System type, pure black and white, no radius, no shadow, headline pushed to the edges. The raw HTML structure is the decoration.

naming.scope: 机制名「box-shadow:4px 4px 0」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 粗黑描边 + 硬投影 + 高饱和色块
definition.en: Thick outlines, hard offset shadows, loud blocks

distinction.zh: 2–3px 纯黑描边、4–6px 无模糊位移阴影、荧光色块；圆角可有可无，但阴影必须是硬的，按下时位移要真。
distinction.en: A 2–3px black outline, a 4–6px zero-blur offset shadow, fluorescent fills. Radius optional; the shadow must stay hard and the press must really move.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：二值化图 + 复印噪点 + 手写打字机混排 + 歪斜贴纸的手法集合，没有单一实现机制。）

definition.zh: 像复印机印坏的小册子
definition.en: A photocopier having a bad day

distinction.zh: 高对比二值化图 + 复印噪点 + 手写与打字机混排 + 歪斜贴纸；不对齐才是对的，边缘要有脏。
distinction.en: Hard-threshold images, copier noise, typewriter and handwriting mixed, skewed stickers. Misalignment is the point, and the edges must be dirty.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：故意错位/冲突/诡异配色，机制上等于不套用既有规则，无唯一实现。）

definition.zh: 故意打破所有惯例
definition.en: Every convention broken on purpose

distinction.zh: 错位网格、冲突字体、诡异配色、非常规交互；必须留一条清晰的主动线，否则只是坏设计而不是反设计。
distinction.en: Off-grid, clashing faces, awkward colour, unconventional interaction. Keep one clear path through — otherwise it is merely bad design.

naming.scope: 机制名「Experimental type」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 字本身就是图像
definition.en: The letterform is the image

distinction.zh: 可变字体极端轴值 + 字形变形拉伸叠印 + 破格网格；可读性只保住一个层级即可，其余交给张力。
distinction.en: Extreme variable-font axes, distorted and overprinted glyphs, a broken grid. Only one level needs to stay legible; the rest is tension.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：系统窗口边框、蓝色下划线链接、表格布局、访客计数器的 Web 1.0 组合，无唯一机制。）

definition.zh: 像 1998 年的网页
definition.en: A page from 1998

distinction.zh: 系统窗口边框、蓝色带下划线的超链接、表格布局、访客计数器；克制地怀旧，不要真的用 <blink>。
distinction.en: System window chrome, blue underlined links, table layout, a hit counter. Nostalgic on purpose — skip the actual <blink>.

naming.scope: 机制名「background-image:linear-gradient」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 镀铬、半透明、液态形体
definition.en: Chrome, translucency, liquid forms

distinction.zh: 金属渐变文字 + 亚克力质感 + 气泡与光晕；冷色高光要有明确的光源方向，斜体是必需的。
distinction.en: Metallic gradient type, acrylic surfaces, bubbles and bloom. Give the cool speculars one consistent light direction — and italics are mandatory.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：太空时代插画 + 橙棕配色 + 圆角科技造型 + 宽几何无衬线，无唯一机制。）

definition.zh: 上世纪想象的未来
definition.en: The future as the last century imagined it

distinction.zh: 太空时代插画 + 橙棕配色 + 圆角科技造型；字体用宽体几何无衬线，别用现代科技风的窄体。
distinction.en: Space-age illustration, burnt-orange palette, rounded techno forms, wide geometric sans. Never a modern narrow tech face.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：蒸汽波是粉紫青配色、透视网格地面、标题 RGB 分离三件事叠加，单拎 rotateX 只覆盖网格地面那半，没有能唯一复现的单一机制名。）

definition.zh: 粉紫落日与网格地平线
definition.en: A magenta sunset over a grid horizon

distinction.zh: 粉紫青三色 + 透视网格地面 + 全角标题 + 石膏像；刻意的 VHS 噪点与色偏，标题要有 RGB 分离。
distinction.en: Magenta/cyan/violet, a perspective grid floor, full-width type, plaster busts, deliberate VHS noise and an RGB-split headline.

naming.scope: 机制名「image-rendering:pixelated」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 每个像素都是手放的
definition.en: Every pixel placed by hand

distinction.zh: 固定像素网格 + image-rendering:pixelated + 有限调色板；缩放必须整数倍，动画走 steps() 不走补间。
distinction.en: A fixed pixel grid, image-rendering: pixelated, a limited palette. Scale by whole integers, and animate with steps() — never tween.

naming.scope: 机制名「background-image:repeating-radial-gradient」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 折线、圆点、撞色几何
definition.en: Squiggles, dots, clashing geometry

distinction.zh: 80 年代孟菲斯派：饱和撞色 + 波浪与网格图案 + 随机散布几何；构图故意不对称，但底色必须统一。
distinction.en: The 80s Memphis school — clashing saturated colour, squiggle and grid patterns, scattered geometry, deliberately asymmetric over one unifying ground.

naming.scope: 机制名「background-image:linear-gradient(180deg)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 黑底、细渐变、一条发光的线
definition.en: Black ground, subtle gradients, one glowing line

distinction.zh: 近黑背景 + 极低饱和文字 + 单一冷光焦点；渐变必须细，一旦浓就变成廉价科技感。边框用 1px 微亮。
distinction.en: Near-black ground, desaturated text, one cold light focus. Keep gradients faint — heavy ones read as cheap tech. Borders are 1px, barely lit.

naming.scope: 机制名「Bento grid」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 大小不一的方块拼满一屏
definition.en: Unequal tiles tiling the whole screen

distinction.zh: 一套统一圆角与间距的模块网格，每格一个信息单元；格子跨列跨行制造节奏，禁止格内再分栏。
distinction.en: A modular grid with one radius and one gap; one idea per tile. Rhythm comes from spans — never sub-divide a tile.

naming.scope: 机制名「grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr))」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一屏之内看完全部指标
definition.en: Every metric on one screen

distinction.zh: 卡片化 KPI + 图表网格 + 状态色（升/降）；密度高但要有明确的视觉层级与对齐基线，数字用等宽。
distinction.en: KPI cards, a chart grid, semantic up/down colour. High density still needs one hierarchy, one baseline, and tabular numerals.

naming.scope: 机制名「Elevation」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 纸片有厚度，光从上方来
definition.en: Sheets with elevation, light from above

distinction.zh: 海拔阴影体系 + 主色/次色/表面色 token + 涟漪反馈；阴影只表示层级，不当装饰。
distinction.en: An elevation shadow system, primary/secondary/surface tokens, ripple feedback. Shadows encode depth, never decoration.

naming.scope: 机制名「Terminal UI」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 整站像一个终端会话
definition.en: The whole site is a terminal session

distinction.zh: 等宽字体 + 命令行提示符 + 光标 + 制表符边框；配色沿用 solarized / gruvbox / nord 这类既成主题，别自创。
distinction.en: Monospace, a prompt, a cursor, box-drawing frames. Borrow an established scheme — solarized, gruvbox, nord — never invent one.

naming.scope: 机制名「background-image:radial-gradient(),radial-gradient()」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 几团颜色互相渗透
definition.en: Colour blooms bleeding into each other

distinction.zh: 多个 radial-gradient 叠加 + 大半径柔化 + 缓慢位移；颜色数控制在 3–4 个，超了就变脏。
distinction.en: Stack radial gradients, soften them wide, drift slowly. Three or four hues maximum — more turns muddy.

naming.scope: 机制名「three.js」（library 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 整页就是一个可进入的场景
definition.en: The page is a scene you enter

distinction.zh: WebGL 场景 + 滚动驱动相机 + DOM 只放少量文字；必须给静态首帧与降级路径，否则弱设备直接白屏。
distinction.en: A WebGL scene with a scroll-driven camera and very little DOM text. Always ship a static first frame and a fallback, or weak devices see white.

naming.scope: 机制名「three.js flatShading」（library 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 看得见每一个三角面
definition.en: Every triangle stays visible

distinction.zh: 刻意保留低面数 + 平面着色（flat shading）+ 明确的面间明暗差；绝不开平滑法线，那会毁掉整个语言。
distinction.en: Keep the poly count low, use flat shading, let adjacent faces differ clearly. Never smooth the normals — that kills the whole language.

naming.scope: 机制名「transform:rotatex(60deg) rotatez(45deg)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 30° 斜轴上的小世界
definition.en: A small world on a 30° axis

distinction.zh: 固定 30° 等轴投影、无透视收缩、三面明暗固定；所有物件共用一套光照与网格，一处破轴全盘就散。
distinction.en: A fixed 30° axonometric projection, no perspective convergence, three constant face values. One light and one grid for everything — one broken axis ruins it.

naming.scope: 机制名「text-shadow:0 0 8px」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 霓虹、高密度信息、雨夜都市
definition.en: Neon, dense information, a wet city at night

distinction.zh: 深色底 + 两种霓虹色（品红/青）+ 扫描线与故障；信息要"过载"，但正文仍需 4.5:1 对比。
distinction.en: Dark ground, two neon hues (magenta/cyan), scanlines and glitch. Overload the information — but keep body text at 4.5:1.

naming.scope: 机制名「filter:grayscale(1)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 照片去色，字压上去
definition.en: Desaturate the photo, set type over it

distinction.zh: 全站灰度 + 一张主图占 60% 以上 + 大衬线标题压图；只允许一个彩色元素破局，那就是 CTA。
distinction.en: Full greyscale, one image over 60% of the frame, a serif headline across it. Exactly one colour element may break it — the CTA.

naming.scope: 机制名「Fashion editorial」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 像时装杂志的封面
definition.en: A fashion cover, not a homepage

distinction.zh: 超大细衬线标题压人像 + 极少 UI + 大量出血图；导航退成一行小字，CTA 只是一条下划线。
distinction.en: An oversized light serif over a portrait, almost no UI, full-bleed imagery. The nav shrinks to one small line; the CTA is just an underline.

naming.scope: 机制名「transform:rotate()」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 像手撕纸片贴出来的版面
definition.en: Torn paper, taped down

distinction.zh: 纸质纹理 + 撕边遮罩 + 轻微旋转与投影 + 手写标注；每片素材角度不同才有拼贴感，白色缝隙要清脆。
distinction.en: Paper texture, torn-edge masks, slight rotations with shadows, handwritten notes. Vary every angle and keep the white gutters crisp.

naming.scope: 机制名「Scrollytelling」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 滚动就是翻页
definition.en: Scrolling is turning the page

distinction.zh: 滚动位置驱动章节切换：sticky 画面 + 递进文字；每屏只推进一个信息，进度必须可见。
distinction.en: Scroll position drives chapters — a sticky visual with advancing text. One idea per screen, and always show progress.

naming.scope: 机制名「Split screen」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一半字，一半图，中缝就是版式
definition.en: Half type, half image — the seam is the layout

distinction.zh: 50/50 或 40/60 硬分割 + 两侧独立滚动或对比材质；分割线位置全站保持一致，缝隙不加圆角。
distinction.en: A hard 50/50 or 40/60 split, each side its own material or scroll. Keep the seam in the same place site-wide, and never round it.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：大几何块 + 单一饱和色 + 图形压字 + 出血裁切的构图手法，无唯一机制。）

definition.zh: 几何形当图像用
definition.en: Geometry standing in for imagery

distinction.zh: 大块几何形 + 一个饱和色 + 图形与字重叠；形体裁切要跨出容器边界才有张力。
distinction.en: Big geometric masses, one saturated hue, shapes overlapping the type. Let forms bleed past the container edge or the tension dies.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：整屏海报构图 + 循环动效 + 极少导航的整页取向，非单一机制。）

definition.zh: 一张会动的海报当首页
definition.en: A poster that moves, used as a homepage

distinction.zh: 整屏一张海报构图 + 循环动效（字距/位移/遮罩）+ 极少导航；所有节奏对齐同一个循环长度。
distinction.en: One poster composition filling the viewport, a looping motion (tracking, shift, mask), almost no nav. All timing on one loop length.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：入场/滚动/悬停三层动效 + 统一缓动与时长阶梯的编排策略，非单一机制名。）

definition.zh: 动效是主角，不是点缀
definition.en: Motion is the subject, not the garnish

distinction.zh: 入场/滚动/悬停三层动效编排成一条线，用统一的缓动与时长阶梯；必须尊重 reduced-motion。
distinction.en: Entrance, scroll and hover choreographed as one line with a shared easing and duration ladder. Honour reduced-motion.

naming.scope: 机制名「border-radius:30% 70% 70% 30%」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 没有一条直线
definition.en: Not a single straight line

distinction.zh: blob 形状 + 不规则圆角 + 柔和低饱和色；用 border-radius 四值或 SVG 路径造形，别用对称椭圆。
distinction.en: Blob forms, asymmetric radii, soft muted colour. Shape with four-value radii or SVG paths — symmetric ellipses read as clip-art.

naming.scope: 机制名「rough.js」（library 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 线条有抖动，颜色出框
definition.en: Wobbling strokes, colour outside the lines

distinction.zh: 不规则手绘线 + 蜡笔质感填色 + 手写体标注；线宽要有粗细变化，否则像矢量描边而不是手绘。
distinction.en: Irregular strokes, crayon fills, handwritten notes. Vary stroke weight — even weight reads as vector outline, not hand.

naming.scope: 机制名「stroke-width」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 统一线宽的插画
definition.en: Illustration at one stroke weight

distinction.zh: 全站插画同一线宽（1.5–2px）与同一端点形状；填色只作为线稿背后的色块，绝不替代线。
distinction.en: One stroke weight (1.5–2px) and one cap style everywhere. Colour sits behind the line, never replaces it.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：实景摄影 + 森林绿土色 + 手写点缀；关键在照片真实性，属用图规范。）

definition.zh: 真实的绿，不是品牌绿
definition.en: Real green, not brand green

distinction.zh: 实景摄影 + 森林绿与土色 + 手写点缀；关键是照片真实，避免图库式"可持续插画"和柔焦绿。
distinction.en: Documentary photography, forest greens and earth tones, one handwritten accent. Real photos — skip stock sustainability art and soft-focus green.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：植物 + 明亮金绿 + 新艺术曲线 + 通透玻璃的组合，无唯一实现机制。）

definition.zh: 乐观的绿色未来
definition.en: An optimistic green future

distinction.zh: 植物 + 明亮金绿 + 装饰性新艺术曲线 + 通透玻璃；和赛博朋克相反：明亮、有机、可持续。
distinction.en: Plants, bright gold-greens, art-nouveau curves, clear glass. The inverse of cyberpunk — bright, organic, sustainable.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：多色多字多层的堆叠量，靠统一网格与底色收住，不是单一机制。）

definition.zh: 填满、堆叠、喧闹但有序
definition.en: Full, stacked, loud — and still ordered

distinction.zh: 多色多字体多图层，但用一套网格与一个统一底色收住；阅读焦点仍然只留一个。
distinction.en: Many colours, faces and layers held by one grid and one ground colour. Still exactly one reading focus.

naming.scope: 机制名「Ordered dithering」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一张抖出来的黑白点阵图当整页主角，字是等宽，颜色只有黑与白
definition.en: One dithered black-and-white image carries the page; monospace type, no colour at all

distinction.zh: 把照片压成 1bit：阈值抖动或网点半调，全站只留黑白两色加一款等宽字，标题和正文靠字号拉开层级。抖动是刻意的，不是压缩失真。
distinction.en: Reduce photography to 1-bit with order dithering or halftone, hold the palette to black and white, and let one monospace face carry display and body copy through size alone. The dither is deliberate, not a compression artefact.

naming.scope: 机制名「background-image:radial-gradient(circle)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一块点阵屏加一个旋钮，像硬件面板而不是网页
definition.en: A dot-matrix display and a knob — a hardware panel, not a web page

distinction.zh: 主视觉用 LED 点阵屏，背景是细网格，标签一律等宽大写；按钮画成实体键，带按下位移和轻微投影。整体直角、低饱和、金属灰。
distinction.en: Lead with an LED matrix, lay a hairline grid behind everything, set every label in uppercase mono, and draw buttons as physical keys that travel when pressed. Right angles, desaturated grey, no ornament.

naming.scope: 机制名「Streetwear campaign」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一张满幅人物大片顶在最上面，标题粗到有点过分
definition.en: A full-bleed campaign photo on top, headline heavier than it needs to be

distinction.zh: 首屏就是一张满幅人物照，粗黑无衬线标题压在图上；商品用横滑一排在下面。动效只做位移和缩放，不玩花活。
distinction.en: Open with a full-bleed photo, set the headline in the heaviest grotesque you can justify, and put products in a single horizontal rail under it. Motion is limited to translate and scale.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：近纯白底 + 大留白 + 中性标题 + 极小说明字的比例安排，无唯一机制。）

definition.zh: 白墙、黑字、大留白，标题大而中性，说明字小到几乎听不见
definition.en: White walls, black type, vast margins — big neutral headline, whisper-small captions

distinction.zh: 底色接近纯白但不刺眼；标题用中性无衬线或过渡衬线，字距收一点。展览信息、票务、赞助人一律小字排在底部，中间只放一件作品。
distinction.en: Near-white ground, one neutral sans or transitional serif at display size with tight tracking, and everything logistical — dates, tickets, credits — set small along the base. The middle belongs to a single work.

naming.scope: 机制名「line-height:1.9」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 栏目多、字号小、行距松，用细边框把每一块分开
definition.en: Many columns, small type, generous leading — every block fenced by a hairline

distinction.zh: 信息密度高但不挤：正文 12–13px、行高 1.9，块与块之间只用 1px 细线分隔；配色克制到近乎无色，重点靠加粗和缩进。
distinction.en: Dense but unhurried: 12–13px body at 1.9 leading, blocks separated only by hairlines, a palette that is almost no palette. Emphasis comes from weight and indent, never from colour.

naming.scope: 机制名「max-width:60ch」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一列窄栏、大量留白，链接是深蓝不是亮色
definition.en: A single narrow column, a lot of margin, links in navy rather than a bright accent

distinction.zh: 正文一栏不超过 60 字符，中线对齐；链接用深蓝加下划线，激活态才变色。图片小、少、方，其余交给留白。
distinction.en: Keep the measure under 60 characters on the centre line. Links are navy with an underline and only change on activation. Images stay small, few and square; everything else is margin.

naming.scope: 机制名「Radio culture」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 深底加一块高饱和色，节目单是列表，播放器常驻底部
definition.en: A dark ground, one saturated block, a schedule as a plain list, a player that never leaves

distinction.zh: 背景近黑，主色只用一个高饱和色；节目按时间排成无边框列表，当前节目用色块标出。底部常驻一条播放器，字号收紧、字距拉近。
distinction.en: Near-black ground, exactly one saturated accent. The schedule is an unfenced list ordered by time, the current slot marked by a colour block, and a player bar that stays put. Type tight, tracking tighter.

naming.scope: 机制名「letter-spacing:0.2em」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 近黑的底、金色细线、衬线标题，产品放正中间
definition.en: Near-black ground, gold hairlines, a serif headline and the product dead centre

distinction.zh: 底色压到近黑，分隔线用 1px 香槟金；标题是衬线，正文小到 9px 并拉开字距。产品永远居中，四周全是留白。
distinction.en: Push the ground to near-black and draw every divider in a 1px champagne gold. Serif headline, 9px body with open tracking, the product always centred and nothing crowding it.

naming.scope: 机制名「table-layout:fixed」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 表格优先，行高固定，字号极小，颜色只用来标状态
definition.en: Table first: fixed row heights, tiny type, colour used only to mark state

distinction.zh: 一切对齐到列：站名、时间、站台三列，行高恒定 22px；红蓝是功能色不是装饰色。信息层级靠字重和灰阶，不靠色块。
distinction.en: Everything snaps to columns — name, time, platform — at a fixed 22px row height. Red and blue are functional signals, never decoration. Hierarchy comes from weight and grey level, not fills.

naming.scope: 机制名「backdrop-filter:blur() saturate()」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 半透明彩色叠在一起，圆角很大，阴影很浅
definition.en: Translucent colour layers stacked, generous rounding, barely-there shadow

distinction.zh: 彩色层用 40%–70% 透明叠加，背景是柔和渐变；圆角 18–22px，阴影浅到几乎看不见。文字压在玻璃上，靠字重而不是描边保证可读。
distinction.en: Stack colour layers at 40–70% opacity over a soft gradient, round corners to 18–22px, and keep shadows almost invisible. Type sits on the glass and stays readable through weight, not outlines.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（视觉流派：米黄旧纸底 + 细线平涂插画 + 中文名/拉丁双名/采集地的小字图注，无唯一机制。）

definition.zh: 米白纸底、手绘标本、拉丁学名用小字排在下面
definition.en: Cream paper, drawn specimens, Latin binomials set small beneath

distinction.zh: 底色偏米黄像旧纸；插画用细线平涂，不描边不渐变。每张卡下方是中文学名 + 拉丁双名 + 采集地，字小但整齐。
distinction.en: A cream ground that reads as old paper, plates drawn in flat fills with hairline outlines, and each card footed by local name, Latin binomial and locality in small orderly type.

naming.scope: 机制名「Type specimen」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 页面本身就是一张字体样本：大字试样、极窄行距、等宽小字标注
definition.en: The page is the specimen: giant glyphs, razor-tight leading, mono metadata

distinction.zh: 主视觉直接排大字试样，行距压到 0.86；字重、字号、字距用等宽小字标在旁边。不放大图，页面说的一切都由字承担。
distinction.en: Set the specimen itself as the hero at 0.86 leading, and annotate weight, size and tracking in mono down the side. No imagery: the type carries every claim on the page.

naming.scope: 机制名「animation-timing-function:steps(36)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 真实的大陆在自转，不是贴图
definition.en: Real continents, actually rotating

distinction.zh: 正射投影（orthographic）逐帧把经纬网格投到圆盘上：每个屏幕点反解出经纬度，查陆海掩膜决定画不画，再按 cos(角距) 做球面明暗。这里把 36 帧（每 10° 经度）烤成一张 6×6 精灵图，用 steps() 切帧——横向步进列、纵向步进行，两条动画各管一个 background-position 分量。
distinction.en: Orthographic projection, frame by frame: invert each screen point to lon/lat, test it against a land mask, then shade by cos of the angular distance. Here 36 frames (10° of longitude each) are baked into a 6×6 sprite and stepped with steps() — one animation walks the columns, another the rows.

naming.scope: 机制名「box-shadow:0 0 0 4px」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 干净的点阵底图，上面跑一条航线
definition.en: A clean dot plate with one route drawn across it

distinction.zh: 底图是等距圆柱投影的规则点阵：先把陆地栅格化，再按单元格覆盖率（≥34%）决定是否落点，孤点剔除，南极裁掉——点距约为点径的四倍才够干净。节点用同心 box-shadow 做脉冲环，航线用 border-radius 的一段圆弧配 clip-path 逐段画出。
distinction.en: The plate is a regular grid in equirectangular projection: rasterise the land, keep a cell only if ≥34% covered, drop orphans, clip Antarctica. Pitch should be about four times the dot radius. Nodes pulse with concentric box-shadows; the route is an arc of a rounded box revealed by clip-path.

naming.scope: 机制名「white-space」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 同一份地理数据，落到字符网格上
definition.en: The same geometry, resampled onto a character grid

distinction.zh: 字符格不是正方形（约 1:2），所以纵向要多压一倍才不变形。每格取陆地覆盖率，≥42% 给 █，≥18% 给 ·，其余留空——两级就够，三级以上开始显脏。
distinction.en: Character cells are about 1:2, so squash twice as much vertically. Take land coverage per cell: ≥42% gets █, ≥18% gets ·, the rest stays blank. Two levels is enough — three starts to look dirty.

naming.scope: 机制名「animation-delay:calc(var(--i)*20ms)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一道斜波扫过整片字符
definition.en: One diagonal wave sweeping the field

distinction.zh: 整片同一个字形，只用 animation-delay 沿索引递增制造相位差；delay 用负值动画就不必等第一轮跑完。
distinction.en: One glyph everywhere; phase comes from an animation-delay that grows with the cell index. Negative delays start the field mid-cycle.

naming.scope: 机制名「font-weight」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 从左到右越来越"重"
definition.en: Ink weight climbing left to right

distinction.zh: 按列给不同的字重与透明度，就得到一条可读的密度梯度——字符版的灰阶条。
distinction.en: Weight and alpha per column give a readable density ramp — the character-grid version of a greyscale wedge.

naming.scope: 机制名「CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText」（platform 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 越暗的地方字符越"重"
definition.en: Darker areas take heavier glyphs

distinction.zh: 把亮度 0–255 映射到一张按笔画密度排序的字符表（" .:-=+*#%@"），这一步叫 luminance ramp。表的单调性比长度重要。
distinction.en: Map luminance 0–255 onto a glyph table ordered by ink density (" .:-=+*#%@") — the luminance ramp. Monotonicity matters more than length.

naming.scope: 机制名「Ordered dithering」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 只有四级墨，看着是连续渐变
definition.en: Four ink levels reading as a smooth gradient

distinction.zh: 4×4 Bayer 矩阵做阈值抖动，用 ░▒▓█ 表现灰阶。它的花纹是确定性的，所以放大不会像噪点抖动那样"沙沙"。
distinction.en: A 4×4 Bayer threshold matrix over ░▒▓█. The pattern is deterministic, so it never fizzes the way noise dithering does when scaled.

naming.scope: 机制名「CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText()」（platform 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 同样一格字符，四倍分辨率
definition.en: Four times the resolution per cell

distinction.zh: U+2800 盲文块每格 2×4 点，是终端里能拿到的最高有效分辨率；btop、gnuplot 的字符图都靠它。
distinction.en: U+2800 braille cells pack 2×4 dots — the highest usable resolution in a terminal. btop and gnuplot lean on it.

naming.scope: 机制名「mask-image:linear-gradient」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一列列字符往下掉
definition.en: Columns of glyphs falling

distinction.zh: 每列一个独立速度与偏移的字符流，头部最亮、尾部指数衰减；尾迹用一层 mask 渐变，比逐字设透明度便宜得多。
distinction.en: One stream per column, each with its own speed and offset: bright head, exponential tail. A single gradient mask is far cheaper than per-glyph opacity.

naming.scope: 机制名「FIGlet」（library 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 用字符拼出的巨大标题
definition.en: A headline built out of characters

distinction.zh: FIGlet / toilet 字体把每个字母展开成多行字符网格，标准 banner 高 6 行；CI 日志与 CLI 欢迎页的常见开场。
distinction.en: FIGlet fonts expand each letter into a multi-row grid; the standard banner is six rows. Ubiquitous in CI logs and CLI splash screens.

naming.scope: 机制名「U+2500 BOX DRAWING」（platform 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 纯字符画出来的面板
definition.en: A panel drawn entirely in glyphs

distinction.zh: U+2500 制表符（─│┌┐└┘├┤┬┴┼）拼边框与分栏，是 ncurses / TUI 的基本材料；宽度必须按字符数算，不能按像素。
distinction.en: The U+2500 box-drawing range builds frames and splits — the raw material of ncurses and every TUI. Size everything in characters, never pixels.

naming.scope: 机制名「animation-timing-function:steps(1)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一个字符位上的旋转
definition.en: Rotation inside a single cell

distinction.zh: 一组等宽帧（⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏ 或 |/-\）用 steps() 逐帧切换，80–120ms 一帧最不晃眼。
distinction.en: A ring of equal-width frames stepped with steps(); 80–120ms per frame reads best.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（约定：用 U+2588 整块与 ▏▎▍▌▋▊▉ 八分之一块拼条（tqdm/pv 的画法），属文本渲染惯例，没有 API 机制。）

definition.zh: 方块一格一格填满
definition.en: Blocks filling one cell at a time

distinction.zh: 整格用 █，余数用 ▏▎▍▌▋▊▉ 做八分之一细分——tqdm / pv 就是这么画的，比像素条更容易对齐日志。
distinction.en: Full cells in █, the remainder in the ▏▎▍▌▋▊▉ eighths — how tqdm and pv draw it, and it aligns with log text.

naming.scope: 机制名「caret-shape:block」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 那个方块一直在呼吸
definition.en: The block that never stops blinking

distinction.zh: VT100 光标是 530ms 硬切（steps(1)），不是淡入淡出；软光标才用 opacity 过渡。
distinction.en: A VT100 cursor hard-switches about every 530ms with steps(1) — only soft cursors fade.

naming.scope: 无唯一机制名（约定：定高容器 + 整体 translateY 或容器 scrollTop 自动滚底两路都能实现，无唯一机制。）

definition.zh: 一行行日志自己往上走
definition.en: Log lines climbing on their own

distinction.zh: 定高容器 + 整体 translateY，进入时给一档 opacity 台阶；时间戳与数字用等宽对齐，日志才不抖。
distinction.en: A fixed-height box, one translateY on the block, an opacity step as rows enter. Tabular figures keep timestamps from jittering.

naming.scope: 机制名「Sparkline」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一行字符里的趋势线
definition.en: A trend line inside one line of text

distinction.zh: 把序列归一化到 ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ 八级块字符，一行字就是一张图；状态栏里最省地方的可视化。
distinction.en: Normalise the series onto the ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ eighths — one line of text becomes a chart. The cheapest viz in any status bar.

naming.scope: 机制名「font-variant-numeric」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 用方块排出来的排行榜
definition.en: A ranking drawn in blocks

distinction.zh: 标签左对齐、条形用 █ 重复、数值右对齐等宽——CLI 报表的标准三栏，宽度按最长标签定。
distinction.en: Left-aligned labels, repeated █ bars, right-aligned tabular values — the standard three columns of a CLI report, sized by the longest label.

naming.scope: 机制名「GLSL sin()」（platform 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 字符组成的流动色场
definition.en: A flowing colour field made of glyphs

distinction.zh: 多个正弦叠加（sin(x)+sin(y)+sin(x+y+t)）求值后查字符表，是 demoscene 的入门题；这里用一层渐变裁进字里。
distinction.en: Sum a few sines — sin(x)+sin(y)+sin(x+y+t) — and look the value up in the ramp. The demoscene starter exercise; here a gradient is clipped into the glyphs.

naming.scope: 机制名「background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg)」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 像老显示器那样有横纹和辉光
definition.en: Old-monitor stripes and phosphor glow

distinction.zh: 偶数行叠半透明黑（repeating-linear-gradient），再加 text-shadow 磷光与极轻的桶形畸变；扫描线间距必须是整像素，否则会摩尔纹。
distinction.en: Overlay a repeating-linear-gradient on alternate rows, add a phosphor text-shadow and a touch of barrel distortion. Keep the stripe pitch on whole pixels or it moirés.

naming.scope: 机制名「animation-timing-function:steps」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 一个字一个字打出来
definition.en: One character at a time

distinction.zh: 等宽字体 + ch 单位宽度配 steps(n)，才不会露出半个字；变宽字体必须改成逐字 span。
distinction.en: Monospace plus a ch-unit width stepped with steps(n) — anything else shows half a glyph. Proportional type needs per-character spans.

naming.scope: 机制名「Text scramble」（pattern 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 字符被替换成乱码再复原
definition.en: Glyphs corrupt into noise, then resolve

distinction.zh: 随机替换（scramble）配 steps 抽帧，替换池只取同宽字符，字段宽度才不会跳。
distinction.en: Scramble on stepped frames, drawing only from same-width glyphs so the field never reflows.

naming.scope: 机制名「background-color:currentColor」（css 命名空间，四轮命名复核）

definition.zh: 半圆表盘也能用字符画
definition.en: Even a dial can be typed

distinction.zh: 半圆刻度用 ╱╲│ 排布，指针一格反色；htop / btop 的资源表就是这套，读数必须等宽。
distinction.en: Arrange ╱╲│ into a half-circle scale and invert one cell for the needle — the htop / btop resource dial. Keep the readout tabular.

naming.scope: MDN: align-content

definition.zh: align-content 沿块的交叉/纵轴分配多行（或多条轨道）之间的剩余空间，取值如 center、space-between、stretch。
definition.en: align-content distributes spare space between multiple lines or tracks along the block/cross axis (center, space-between, stretch).

distinction.zh: 与 align-items 的区别：items 对齐的是单行内部的项目，content 对齐的是行与行（或轨道与轨道）之间的分布。
distinction.en: align-items aligns items inside one line; align-content aligns the lines/tracks themselves.

naming.scope: MDN: align-items

definition.zh: align-items 设置弹性/网格项目在其行内沿交叉轴的默认对齐方式，如 stretch、center、baseline。
definition.en: align-items sets the default cross-axis alignment of items inside their line (stretch, center, baseline).

distinction.zh: 与 align-self 的区别：items 是容器级默认值，self 是单个项目覆盖；与 align-content 的区别见该条。
distinction.en: align-self overrides per item; align-content spaces the lines themselves.

naming.scope: MDN: align-tracks

definition.zh: align-tracks 在 masonry（砖石）布局中为纵轴上每条轨道单独设置对齐，值列表按轨道逐条生效。
definition.en: align-tracks sets per-track block-axis alignment in masonry layout, as a list applied track by track.

distinction.zh: 与 align-content 的区别：content 用一个值分布所有行；tracks 允许每行不同，且仅用于 masonry。
distinction.en: align-content uses one value for all lines; align-tracks is masonry-only and per-track.

naming.scope: MDN: alignment-baseline

definition.zh: alignment-baseline 指定行内对象与父级对齐时以哪条基线为准，如 alphabetic、central、middle（SVG 文本排版）。
definition.en: alignment-baseline specifies which baseline of an inline object aligns to the parent (alphabetic, central, middle) — SVG text layout.

distinction.zh: 与 dominant-baseline 的区别：dominant 确定元素自身用于对齐的基线，alignment 指定其对齐到父级的哪条基线。
distinction.en: dominant-baseline picks the element's own aligning baseline; alignment-baseline picks the parent baseline.

naming.scope: MDN: all

definition.zh: all 是速写属性，把除 direction、unicode-bidi 外的所有 CSS 属性重置为 initial、inherit、unset 或 revert。
definition.en: all is a shorthand resetting every CSS property (except direction and unicode-bidi) to initial, inherit, unset or revert.

distinction.zh: 与逐个写 reset 的区别：all:revert 一条声明回退到 UA/用户样式，是样式隔离的标准做法。
distinction.en: one declaration reverts everything, the standard style-isolation move.

naming.scope: MDN: anchor-scope

definition.zh: anchor-scope 限制 anchor-name 的可见范围（如 all、axis x），使同名锚点只在作用域内被引用，避免嵌套重复锚点串扰。
definition.en: anchor-scope limits the visibility of anchor-name (all, axis x) so same-named anchors only resolve within scope.

distinction.zh: 与 anchor-name 的区别：name 声明锚点，scope 约束谁能引用它；无 scope 时全文档同名取第一个。
distinction.en: anchor-name declares; anchor-scope constrains resolution scope.

naming.scope: MDN: animation-delay

definition.zh: animation-delay 设定动画在应用后等待多久才开始，负值表示动画从中途开始播放。
definition.en: animation-delay waits before an animation starts; negative values start mid-animation.

distinction.zh: 与 animation-duration 的区别：duration 是播放时长，delay 是开始前的等待；负 delay 相当于跳过前段。
distinction.en: duration is play time; delay is wait time (negative = skip ahead).

naming.scope: MDN: animation-duration

definition.zh: animation-duration 设定一次动画循环的时长，0s 表示无过渡的直接跳变。
definition.en: animation-duration sets one cycle length; 0s means an instant jump.

distinction.zh: 与 transition-duration 的区别：animation-duration 属于 @keyframes 动画体系，可循环多关键帧；transition 只在状态变化时插值。
distinction.en: animation runs keyframes (loopable); transition interpolates state changes only.

naming.scope: MDN: animation-name

definition.zh: animation-name 把 @keyframes 定义的关键帧序列绑定到元素，none 表示无动画。
definition.en: animation-name binds a @keyframes sequence to the element; none removes it.

distinction.zh: 与 @keyframes 本身的区别：keyframes 是定义，name 是引用；名字不匹配时动画静默失效。
distinction.en: @keyframes defines, animation-name references; a mismatch silently no-ops.

naming.scope: MDN: animation-range-end

definition.zh: animation-range-end 设定 scroll/view 时间线上动画停止应用的位置（如 entry 结束、容器 80% 处）。
definition.en: animation-range-end marks where an animation stops applying on a scroll/view timeline (e.g. end of entry, 80% of range).

distinction.zh: 与 animation-range-start 成对定义播放区间；与 animation-duration 的区别：滚动驱动里时长被区间取代。
distinction.en: pairs with animation-range-start; scroll-driven animations replace duration with a range.

naming.scope: MDN: animation-range-start

definition.zh: animation-range-start 设定 scroll/view 时间线上动画开始应用的位置（如 entry 10%、cover 起点）。
definition.en: animation-range-start marks where an animation starts applying on a scroll/view timeline (entry 10%, cover start).

distinction.zh: 与 animation-delay 的区别：滚动驱动没有“等几秒再播”，只有区间起点随滚动推进。
distinction.en: scroll-driven ranges replace delays with scroll positions.

naming.scope: MDN: animation-timeline

definition.zh: animation-timeline 把动画的进度来源从时间换成 scroll()、view() 或具名时间线，是滚动驱动动画的开关。
definition.en: animation-timeline swaps an animation's progress source from time to scroll(), view() or a named timeline.

distinction.zh: 与 animation-duration 的区别：挂在滚动时间线时 duration 不再控制播放，进度完全由滚动决定。
distinction.en: on a scroll timeline, progress is scroll-driven, duration is ignored.

naming.scope: MDN: animation-trigger

definition.zh: animation-trigger 把动画绑定到触发器（如 scroll 触发的 timeline-trigger），由触发条件而不是元素挂载启动动画。
definition.en: animation-trigger binds an animation to a trigger (e.g. a scroll trigger) so it starts on a condition, not on element mount.

distinction.zh: 与 animation-play-state 的区别：play-state 是手动的运行开关，trigger 是声明式的启动条件。
distinction.en: play-state is a manual toggle; trigger is declarative start conditions.

naming.scope: MDN: appearance

definition.zh: appearance（常写 none）关闭表单控件的平台默认外观，使按钮、复选框可完全自绘。
definition.en: appearance (usually none) turns off native widget chrome so buttons and checkboxes can be fully custom-styled.

distinction.zh: 与 :checked 等状态伪类的区别：appearance 去掉默认皮，状态伪类仍负责状态样式；两者配合才能既自绘又可用。
distinction.en: appearance strips the default skin; state pseudo-classes still drive state styles.

naming.scope: MDN: background

definition.zh: background 是背景体系的速写属性，一条声明可同时设置颜色、图片、位置、尺寸、重复与裁切。
definition.en: background is the background shorthand: color, image, position, size, repeat and clip in one declaration.

distinction.zh: 与 background-color 等分项的区别：速写会把未写出的分项重置为默认值，混用易覆盖；单独分项更可控。
distinction.en: the shorthand resets unspecified longhands to defaults.

naming.scope: MDN: background-attachment

definition.zh: background-attachment 决定背景相对什么固定：scroll（随元素）、fixed（相对视口）、local（随内容滚动）。
definition.en: background-attachment fixes the background to the element (scroll), the viewport (fixed) or the content (local).

distinction.zh: 与 background-origin 的区别：attachment 管滚动参照系，origin 管定位原点；fixed 是视差感背景的核心机制。
distinction.en: attachment picks the scroll reference; origin picks the positioning origin. fixed powers parallax-like backgrounds.

naming.scope: MDN: background-blend-mode

definition.zh: background-blend-mode 让同一元素的多层背景（颜色与图片、图片与图片）之间按指定混合模式合成。
definition.en: background-blend-mode composites an element's background layers with blend modes (multiply, screen, overlay...).

distinction.zh: 与 mix-blend-mode 的区别：background 版只混合元素自己的背景层，不影响与下方内容的合成。
distinction.en: background version blends its own layers only; mix-blend-mode blends with the backdrop.

naming.scope: MDN: background-clip

definition.zh: background-clip 限定背景绘制到哪个盒子：border-box、padding-box、content-box、text（文字镂空填充）。
definition.en: background-clip confines painting to border-box, padding-box, content-box or text (text filled by the background).

distinction.zh: 与 background-origin 的区别：origin 管背景定位原点，clip 管绘制边界；text 值配合透明文字做渐变文字。
distinction.en: origin sets the positioning origin; clip sets the paint boundary; text powers gradient text.

naming.scope: MDN: background-color

definition.zh: background-color 设置元素的背景色，绘制在最底层，图片透明处会透出。
definition.en: background-color paints the bottom-most background layer, visible through transparent image areas.

distinction.zh: 与 background-image 的区别：image 在 color 之上绘制；两者同属 background 速写的分项。
distinction.en: images paint above the color; both are background longhands.

naming.scope: MDN: background-image

definition.zh: background-image 设置一层或多层背景图，可以是 url()、渐变函数或多层叠加，先声明的层在上。
definition.en: background-image sets one or more background layers (url(), gradients), earlier layers painted on top.

distinction.zh: 与 元素的区别：背景图不进布局、无语义，装饰用背景图，内容图用 img。
distinction.en: backgrounds carry no semantics and no layout box; content images use .

naming.scope: MDN: background-origin

definition.zh: background-origin 指定背景图定位坐标系从哪个盒子开始：border-box、padding-box、content-box。
definition.en: background-origin sets which box the background positioning area starts from: border-box, padding-box, content-box.

distinction.zh: 与 background-clip 的区别：origin 管坐标原点，clip 管画到哪里为止；两者可分别设置。
distinction.en: origin = coordinate origin; clip = paint boundary.

naming.scope: MDN: background-position

definition.zh: background-position 在定位区内放置背景图，支持关键词（center/top）、百分比与长度，百分比按（容器-图片）剩余比例计算。
definition.en: background-position places the image inside the positioning area with keywords, percentages and lengths.

distinction.zh: 与 background-origin 的区别：position 是坐标值，origin 是坐标系；百分比含义依赖两者。
distinction.en: position is the coordinate; origin is the coordinate system.

naming.scope: MDN: background-repeat

definition.zh: background-repeat 控制背景图是否以及如何平铺：repeat、space（留缝不裁切）、round（缩放凑整）、no-repeat。
definition.en: background-repeat tiles the image: repeat, space (gaps, no crop), round (scale to fit), no-repeat.

distinction.zh: 与 background-size 的区别：size 先定单张尺寸，repeat 再决定怎么铺；space/round 是平铺算法而非尺寸。
distinction.en: size sets the tile; repeat sets the tiling algorithm (space/round).

naming.scope: MDN: background-size

definition.zh: background-size 设定背景图尺寸：长度/百分比、auto、cover（铺满裁切）、contain（完整容纳）。
definition.en: background-size sets the tile size: lengths/percentages, auto, cover (fill and crop), contain (fit whole).

distinction.zh: cover 与 contain 的区别：cover 保证覆盖但裁掉超出，contain 保证完整但可能留空。
distinction.en: cover fills and crops; contain fits whole and may letterbox.

naming.scope: MDN: baseline-shift

definition.zh: baseline-shift 把行内对象沿基线方向平移（super/sub/长度），用于上标下标和 SVG 行内微调。
definition.en: baseline-shift shifts an inline object along the baseline (super/sub/length) for super/subscripts and SVG tweaks.

distinction.zh: 与 vertical-align 的区别：vertical-align 是 HTML 行内对齐的通用机制，baseline-shift 是 SVG/基线属性族。
distinction.en: vertical-align is the HTML-inline mechanism; baseline-shift belongs to the SVG baseline family.

naming.scope: MDN: baseline-source

definition.zh: baseline-source 在混合行高场景指定参与基线对齐时取第一基线还是最后基线（first/last）。
definition.en: baseline-source picks whether the first or last baseline participates in alignment (first/last).

distinction.zh: 与 dominant-baseline 的区别：source 管用哪条参与对齐，dominant 管元素自身基线的选择。
distinction.en: source = which baseline participates; dominant = the element's own baseline choice.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block

definition.zh: border-block 是逻辑属性速写，按书写方向同时设置块起/块止两侧边框，writing-mode 变化时自动映射。
definition.en: border-block is a logical shorthand styling both block-start and block-end borders, mapped by writing mode.

distinction.zh: 与 border-top/bottom 的区别：物理属性写死上下，逻辑属性随书写模式翻译，国际化布局必备。
distinction.en: physical top/bottom are fixed; logical properties translate with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-end

definition.zh: border-block-end 是块流向末端的边框逻辑速写（宽度/样式/颜色），横排横写时对应 border-bottom。
definition.en: border-block-end is the logical border shorthand at the flow-block end (maps to border-bottom in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 border-bottom 的区别：块止随书写模式映射，bottom 永远是物理下方。
distinction.en: block-end maps with writing mode; bottom is physical.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-start

definition.zh: border-block-start 是块流向起点的边框逻辑速写，横排横写时对应 border-top。
definition.en: border-block-start is the logical border shorthand at the flow-block start (maps to border-top in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 border-top 的区别同所有逻辑/物理对：start 随书写模式，top 不随。
distinction.en: start maps with writing mode; top does not.

naming.scope: MDN: border-bottom

definition.zh: border-bottom 是物理下边框速写（width/style/color），配合 border-radius 参与圆角裁切。
definition.en: border-bottom is the physical bottom border shorthand (width/style/color).

distinction.zh: 与 border-block-end 的区别：物理方向固定，逻辑方向随书写模式；下划线式强调常用它。
distinction.en: physical is fixed; logical maps with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: border-bottom-left-radius

definition.zh: border-bottom-left-radius 单独设置左下角圆角，可给两个值形成椭圆角。
definition.en: border-bottom-left-radius rounds the bottom-left corner; two values make an elliptical corner.

distinction.zh: 与 border-radius 速写的区别：速写四角一起，longhand 单角控制，做不规则圆角卡片的必备。
distinction.en: shorthand does all four; longhand gives per-corner control.

naming.scope: MDN: border-bottom-right-radius

definition.zh: border-bottom-right-radius 单独设置右下角圆角，支持水平/垂直两个半径。
definition.en: border-bottom-right-radius rounds the bottom-right corner with optional elliptical radii.

distinction.zh: 与左下 longhand 的区别只是角位；用于对话框尾角、气泡尖角等单角造型。
distinction.en: same semantics, other corner; used for tail/bubble shaping.

naming.scope: MDN: border-collapse

definition.zh: border-collapse 让相邻单元格边框合并为一条（collapse）或各自独立（separate）。
definition.en: border-collapse merges adjacent cell borders (collapse) or keeps them separate.

distinction.zh: 与 border-spacing 的区别：spacing 仅在 separate 模式下生效，控制格间距。
distinction.en: border-spacing only applies in separate mode.

naming.scope: MDN: border-color

definition.zh: border-color 是四边边框颜色速写，支持 1–4 值的顺时针赋值规则。
definition.en: border-color sets all four border colors with the 1-4 value clockwise rule.

distinction.zh: 与 border 速写的区别：只改颜色不动宽度样式；逻辑方向版本是 border-block-color 等。
distinction.en: changes colors only; logical variants are border-block-color etc.

naming.scope: MDN: border-image-outset

definition.zh: border-image-outset 让边框图像向边框盒外延展指定距离，可超出元素绘制。
definition.en: border-image-outset extends the border image outward beyond the border box.

distinction.zh: 与 border-image-width 的区别：width 管边框图占据的厚度，outset 管向外偏移多少。
distinction.en: width is thickness; outset is outward offset.

naming.scope: MDN: border-image-repeat

definition.zh: border-image-repeat 控制边框图边缘区域如何填充：stretch、repeat、round、space。
definition.en: border-image-repeat fills the border-image edge regions: stretch, repeat, round, space.

distinction.zh: 与 background-repeat 的区别：作用对象是九宫格切片的边框区域而不是背景层。
distinction.en: applies to border-image slices, not background layers.

naming.scope: MDN: border-image-slice

definition.zh: border-image-slice 用四条线把边框图切成九宫格，数值/百分比为切入深度，fill 关键字让中心区域也绘制。
definition.en: border-image-slice cuts the border image into a 3x3 grid; the fill keyword also paints the center.

distinction.zh: 与 border-image-width 的区别：slice 是在原图上切，width 是切出的块铺到多厚。
distinction.en: slice cuts the source; width scales slices onto the box.

naming.scope: MDN: border-image-source

definition.zh: border-image-source 指定用作边框的图像（url 或渐变），替代纯色边框绘制。
definition.en: border-image-source sets the image (url or gradient) used to paint the border.

distinction.zh: 与 border-style 的区别：有图时图覆盖 style 的绘制；渐变边框常由 source+slice+width 组合实现。
distinction.en: the image paints over border-style; gradient borders combine source+slice+width.

naming.scope: MDN: border-image-width

definition.zh: border-image-width 设定边框图像区域的厚度，可超过实际边框宽度使图压到 padding 上。
definition.en: border-image-width sets the border-image area thickness, independent of the actual border width.

distinction.zh: 与 border-width 的区别：width 是真实布局占位，image-width 只影响图的绘制厚度。
distinction.en: border-width affects layout; image-width only painting.

naming.scope: MDN: border-style

definition.zh: border-style 是四边边框线型速写，决定浏览器画出哪种线：实线 solid、虚线 dashed、点线 dotted、双线 double，以及立体感的 groove、ridge、inset、outset。
definition.en: border-style sets the four border styles: solid, dashed, dotted, double, groove, ridge, inset, outset, none.

distinction.zh: 与 border-image 的区别：style 是浏览器画的线型，image 是自定义图；width:0 时 style 不显示。
distinction.en: style paints lines; border-image paints pictures; width 0 hides both.

naming.scope: MDN: border-top-left-radius

definition.zh: border-top-left-radius 单独设置左上角圆角，双值可成椭圆角。
definition.en: border-top-left-radius rounds the top-left corner, optionally elliptical.

distinction.zh: 与速写的区别：单角控制；卡片只圆上角（上左+上右）是常见信息层级手法。
distinction.en: per-corner control; top-only rounding is a common hierarchy cue.

naming.scope: MDN: border-top-right-radius

definition.zh: border-top-right-radius 单独设置右上角圆角，支持椭圆双值。
definition.en: border-top-right-radius rounds the top-right corner, optionally elliptical.

distinction.zh: 与左上 longhand 只差角位；与 border-bottom-right-radius 组合可做胶囊形/水滴形。
distinction.en: per-corner control; combine corners for pill/teardrop shapes.

naming.scope: MDN: border-width

definition.zh: border-width 是四边边框粗细速写，支持长度与 thin/medium/thick 关键字。
definition.en: border-width sets the four border thicknesses (lengths or thin/medium/thick).

distinction.zh: 与 outline-width 的区别：border 占布局空间，outline 不占且不随圆角在旧浏览器裁切。
distinction.en: borders take layout space; outlines do not.

naming.scope: MDN: box-sizing

definition.zh: box-sizing 决定 width/height 是否包含 padding 与 border：content-box（默认，不含）或 border-box（含）。
definition.en: box-sizing decides whether width/height include padding and border: content-box (default) or border-box.

distinction.zh: 与 width 的区别：width 是声明值，box-sizing 决定它指向哪个盒；现代布局默认 border-box 重置。
distinction.en: width is the declaration; box-sizing picks which box it measures.

naming.scope: MDN: break-after

definition.zh: break-after 在元素之后强制或避免分页、分栏、分区域：auto、avoid、page、column、region 等。
definition.en: break-after forces or avoids a page/column/region break after the element (auto, avoid, page, column).

distinction.zh: 与 page-break-after 的区别：break-after 是统一三场景的标准化属性，page-break-* 是旧名。
distinction.en: standardized superset of the legacy page-break-* properties.

naming.scope: MDN: caption-side

definition.zh: caption-side 把 <caption> 表格标题放到表格上方（top）或下方（bottom）。
definition.en: caption-side places the <caption> above (top) or below (bottom) the table.

distinction.zh: 与 text-align 的区别：管的是标题盒相对表格的位置，不是文字对齐。
distinction.en: positions the caption box, not its text.

naming.scope: MDN: caret-shape

definition.zh: caret-shape 改变插入符形状：auto、bar（竖线）、block（块）、underscore（下划线）。
definition.en: caret-shape changes the caret shape: auto, bar, block, underscore.

distinction.zh: 与 caret-color 的区别：一个管颜色一个管形状；块状光标常用于终端风格输入框。
distinction.en: color vs shape; block caret reads terminal-like.

naming.scope: MDN: caret

definition.zh: caret 是 caret-color 与 caret-shape 的速写，一条声明同时定制输入光标的颜色与形状。
definition.en: caret is the shorthand for caret-color and caret-shape.

distinction.zh: 与分项的区别：速写缺省项会重置；只想改颜色时用 caret-color 更稳。
distinction.en: shorthand resets omitted longhands.

naming.scope: MDN: clear

definition.zh: clear 要求元素的左/右/两侧不出现浮动元素，被推到浮动块下方，是浮动布局时代的换行机制。
definition.en: clear pushes the element below left/right/both floats — the classic float-layout line break.

distinction.zh: 与 float 的区别：float 让元素脱流漂浮，clear 让后续元素避开漂浮物；现代布局用 grid/flex 后仅用于文本环绕场景。
distinction.en: float floats; clear avoids floats. Modern layouts rarely need it outside text wrap.

naming.scope: MDN: clip-path

definition.zh: clip-path 用基本形状（inset、circle、ellipse、polygon）、path() 或 SVG 引用裁掉元素可见区域，裁掉处不接收指针事件。
definition.en: clip-path clips an element with basic shapes (inset, circle, ellipse, polygon), path() or an SVG reference.

distinction.zh: 与 mask 的区别：clip 是硬边裁切且只裁自身，mask 用图像的透明度做软边遮罩；与 border-radius 的区别：radius 只圆角，clip 能切任意形状。
distinction.en: clip = hard-edge shape cut; mask = alpha-based soft masking; radius = corners only.

naming.scope: MDN: clip-rule

definition.zh: clip-rule 决定 SVG 裁切路径中自相交区域的填充判定：nonzero 或 evenodd。
definition.en: clip-rule sets nonzero or evenodd fill-rule semantics for SVG clip paths.

distinction.zh: 与 fill-rule 的区别：规则相同但作用对象是 clipPath 内部的形状，不是填充绘制。
distinction.en: same rule values, applied to clipPath children instead of fills.

naming.scope: MDN: column-count

definition.zh: column-count 把块内容分成指定列数的报纸式多栏，内容自动在栏间流动。
definition.en: column-count splits content into a fixed number of newspaper-style columns with automatic flow.

distinction.zh: 与 CSS Grid 的区别：多栏是内容流式分割（无法控制哪块内容在哪栏），Grid 是显式网格放置。
distinction.en: multicol flows content; grid places items explicitly.

naming.scope: MDN: column-fill

definition.zh: column-fill 在定高多栏中控制填充方式：balance（各栏均衡）或 auto（按序填满一栏再下一栏）。
definition.en: column-fill balances content across columns (balance) or fills sequentially (auto) in fixed-height multicol.

distinction.zh: 与 column-count 的区别：count 定列数，fill 定内容分配策略。
distinction.en: count fixes the number; fill fixes the distribution strategy.

naming.scope: MDN: column-rule-color

definition.zh: column-rule-color 设置多栏之间分隔线的颜色。
definition.en: column-rule-color colors the rule between multicol columns.

distinction.zh: 与 column-rule 速写的区别：速写含 width/style/color，此为颜色分项。
distinction.en: color longhand of the column-rule shorthand.

naming.scope: MDN: column-rule-style

definition.zh: column-rule-style 设置多栏分隔线线型（solid、dashed、dotted 等）。
definition.en: column-rule-style sets the rule style between columns (solid, dashed, dotted...).

distinction.zh: 与 border-style 的区别：画在栏间而不是盒边。
distinction.en: paints between columns, not box edges.

naming.scope: MDN: column-rule-width

definition.zh: column-rule-width 设置多栏布局中栏间分隔线的粗细，可用长度或 thin/medium/thick 关键字。
definition.en: column-rule-width sets the rule thickness between columns.

distinction.zh: 与 column-rule 速写的区别：宽度分项；style 非 none 时才可见。
distinction.en: width longhand; invisible when style is none.

naming.scope: MDN: column-span

definition.zh: column-span: all 让元素横跨多栏全部列宽（如多栏文章里的通栏标题），none 则正常在栏内流动。
definition.en: column-span: all makes the element span all columns (a full-width heading inside multicol).

distinction.zh: 与 grid-column: 1 / -1 的区别：span 用于 multicol 流，grid 版用于显式网格。
distinction.en: multicol spanning vs grid full-row placement.

naming.scope: MDN: column-width

definition.zh: column-width 以理想栏宽定义多栏，浏览器按容器宽度算出实际列数（可与 column-count 冲突时取更少列）。
definition.en: column-width states an ideal column width; the browser derives the column count from the container.

distinction.zh: 与 column-count 的区别：width 表达“至少这么宽”，count 表达“就要这么多列”；columns 速写同时给两者。
distinction.en: width is a constraint, count a target; the columns shorthand sets both.

naming.scope: MDN: contain-intrinsic-block-size

definition.zh: contain-intrinsic-block-size 为开启 size containment 的元素提供块轴占位尺寸，跳过的布局测量用这个估计值代替。
definition.en: contain-intrinsic-block-size supplies a placeholder block size for size-contained elements, standing in for skipped measurement.

distinction.zh: 与 contain-intrinsic-height 的区别：logical 版随书写模式，physical 版写死高；虚拟列表用它稳定滚动条。
distinction.en: logical version vs fixed height; the tool that keeps virtualized lists' scrollbars stable.

naming.scope: MDN: bottom

definition.zh: bottom 设定定位元素下边缘与包含块下边界的距离，absolute/fixed/sticky 下含义不同。
definition.en: bottom offsets a positioned element's lower edge from its containing block.

distinction.zh: 与 inset-block-end 的区别：bottom 是物理方向，逻辑版随书写模式翻译。
distinction.en: physical vs the logical inset-block-end.

naming.scope: MDN: left

definition.zh: left 设定定位元素左边缘与包含块左边界的距离。
definition.en: left offsets a positioned element's left edge from its containing block.

distinction.zh: 与 inset-inline-start 的区别：物理左与逻辑行首，RTL 下语义相反。
distinction.en: physical left vs logical inline-start (flips in RTL).

naming.scope: MDN: right

definition.zh: right 设定定位元素右边缘与包含块右边界的距离。
definition.en: right offsets a positioned element's right edge.

distinction.zh: 与 inset-inline-end 的区别：物理右与逻辑行尾，RTL 下语义相反。
distinction.en: physical right vs logical inline-end.

naming.scope: MDN: top

definition.zh: top 设定定位元素上边缘与包含块上边界的距离。
definition.en: top offsets a positioned element's top edge.

distinction.zh: 与 inset-block-start 的区别：物理上与逻辑块首的对应关系随书写模式。
distinction.en: physical top vs logical block-start.

naming.scope: MDN: z-index

definition.zh: z-index 在同一层叠上下文内决定定位/弹性/网格项目的绘制先后，整数值越高越靠上。
definition.en: z-index orders positioned/flex/grid items within one stacking context.

distinction.zh: 与 isolation 的区别：z-index 只在上下文内比较，isolation 创建新上下文把比较范围隔离。
distinction.en: z-index competes within a context; isolation creates one.

naming.scope: MDN: inset-block

definition.zh: inset-block 一次设置块首/块末两侧偏移（inset-block-start 与 inset-block-end）。
definition.en: inset-block sets both block-start and block-end offsets.

distinction.zh: 与 top/bottom 的区别：逻辑方向随书写模式。
distinction.en: logical vs physical top/bottom.

naming.scope: MDN: inset-block-end

definition.zh: inset-block-end 设定元素在块流向末端的偏移，横排横写时对应 bottom。
definition.en: inset-block-end sets the block-end offset (bottom in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 bottom 的区别：逻辑映射 vs 物理固定。
distinction.en: logical mapping vs fixed physical.

naming.scope: MDN: inset-block-start

definition.zh: inset-block-start 设定元素在块流向起点的偏移，横排横写时对应 top。
definition.en: inset-block-start sets the block-start offset (top in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 top 的区别：逻辑映射 vs 物理固定。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: inset-inline

definition.zh: inset-inline 一次设置行首/行末两侧偏移，RTL 布局自动镜像。
definition.en: inset-inline sets both inline-start and inline-end offsets, mirroring in RTL.

distinction.zh: 与 left/right 的区别：逻辑行向 vs 物理左右。
distinction.en: logical inline axis vs physical left/right.

naming.scope: MDN: inset-inline-end

definition.zh: inset-inline-end 设定行流向末端偏移，LTR 时对应 right，RTL 时对应 left。
definition.en: inset-inline-end maps to right in LTR and left in RTL.

distinction.zh: 与 right 的区别：随书写方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-block-end

definition.zh: margin-block-end 设置块流向末端的外边距，横排横写时对应 margin-bottom。
definition.en: margin-block-end sets the logical block-end margin (bottom in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 margin-bottom 的区别：随书写模式映射。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-block-start

definition.zh: margin-block-start 设置块流向起点的外边距，横排横写时对应 margin-top。
definition.en: margin-block-start sets the logical block-start margin.

distinction.zh: 与 margin-top 的区别：随书写模式映射。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-bottom

definition.zh: margin-bottom 设置元素下方外边距，与相邻元素的下边距发生折叠。
definition.en: margin-bottom sets the bottom margin, subject to margin collapsing.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-bottom 的区别：margin 在盒外且可折叠透明，padding 在盒内算背景。
distinction.en: margin is outside and collapsible; padding is inside and painted.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-left

definition.zh: margin-left 设置元素左侧外边距，auto 配合定宽可实现右对齐。
definition.en: margin-left sets the left margin; auto right-aligns fixed-width boxes.

distinction.zh: 与 margin-inline-start 的区别：逻辑版在 RTL 下翻到另一侧。
distinction.en: logical version flips in RTL.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-right

definition.zh: margin-right 设置元素右侧外边距，与右侧相邻元素的外边距折叠取较大值。
definition.en: margin-right sets the right margin.

distinction.zh: 与 margin-inline-end 的区别：逻辑版随方向翻转。
distinction.en: logical version flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-top

definition.zh: margin-top 设置元素上方外边距，参与经典外边距折叠。
definition.en: margin-top sets the top margin, part of margin collapsing.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-top 的区别：折叠只发生在外边距之间。
distinction.en: collapsing only touches margins.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-block-end

definition.zh: padding-block-end 设置块流向末端的内边距，横排横写时对应 padding-bottom。
definition.en: padding-block-end sets the logical block-end padding.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-bottom 的区别：随书写模式映射。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-block-start

definition.zh: padding-block-start 设置块流向起点的内边距。
definition.en: padding-block-start sets the logical block-start padding.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-top 的区别：随书写模式映射。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-bottom

definition.zh: padding-bottom 设置下方内边距，扩大背景绘制区并参与盒尺寸。
definition.en: padding-bottom extends the painted area inside the box.

distinction.zh: 与 margin-bottom 的区别：内边距在边框内、算入元素尺寸。
distinction.en: padding is inside the border and sized.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-left

definition.zh: padding-left 设置左侧内边距，把内容从左边框推开并扩大背景绘制区。
definition.en: padding-left sets the left padding.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-inline-start 的区别：逻辑版随方向翻转。
distinction.en: logical version flips in RTL.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-right

definition.zh: padding-right 设置右侧内边距，预留文字换行前的内部空间。
definition.en: padding-right sets the right padding.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-inline-end 的区别：逻辑版随方向翻转。
distinction.en: logical version flips in RTL.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-top

definition.zh: padding-top 设置上方内边距，常用于给标题留出呼吸空间。
definition.en: padding-top sets the top padding.

distinction.zh: 与 margin-top 的区别：内边距绘制背景且计入盒子。
distinction.en: padding paints and sizes; margin does not.

naming.scope: MDN: position-area

definition.zh: position-area 把锚点周围划成 3×3 网格区域，用 top span-bottom 等值一句话决定锚定元素落在哪个区域。
definition.en: position-area divides the anchor's surroundings into a 3x3 grid; one value places the positioned element in a region.

distinction.zh: 与 position-try 的区别：area 声明首选区域，try 提供放不下时的回退链。
distinction.en: area picks the preferred region; position-try is the fallback chain.

naming.scope: MDN: position-try-fallbacks

definition.zh: position-try（position-try-fallbacks）列出放不下时的回退方案序列，浏览器按序尝试直到完全显示。
definition.en: position-try lists fallback strategies tried in order when the preferred placement overflows.

distinction.zh: 与 position-area 的区别：area 是首选位置，try 是回退；与 @position-try 自定义回退配合。
distinction.en: preferred region vs ordered fallbacks (with @position-try blocks).

naming.scope: MDN: position-try-order

definition.zh: position-try-order 控制回退方案的尝试顺序，可选 most-height/most-width 等按剩余空间择优。
definition.en: position-try-order reorders fallback attempts, e.g. most-height/most-width pick the roomiest option.

distinction.zh: 与 position-try 的区别：try 列出方案，try-order 决定按什么顺序试。
distinction.en: try lists options; try-order orders them.

naming.scope: MDN: position-visibility

definition.zh: position-visibility 在锚定元素快溢出视口时（anchors-visible）自动隐藏，避免弹出层撕裂。
definition.en: position-visibility (anchors-visible) auto-hides the positioned element when it would overflow the viewport.

distinction.zh: 与 overflow 检测脚本的区别：声明式完成“放不下就藏”，无需 JS 测量。
distinction.en: declarative hide-on-overflow, no JS measuring.

naming.scope: MDN: offset

definition.zh: offset 是沿路径动画（motion path）的速写，集合 offset-path、offset-distance、offset-rotate 等分项。
definition.en: offset is the motion-path shorthand combining offset-path, offset-distance, offset-rotate.

distinction.zh: 与 transform: translate 的区别：translate 是直线位移，offset 让元素沿任意 SVG 路径运动并可旋转朝向。
distinction.en: translate is linear; offset follows an arbitrary path with orientation.

naming.scope: MDN: offset-anchor

definition.zh: offset-anchor 指定元素哪个点对齐到运动路径上（默认 center）。
definition.en: offset-anchor picks which point of the element rides the motion path (default center).

distinction.zh: 与 transform-origin 的区别：origin 管变换基准，anchor 管路径对齐点。
distinction.en: transform-origin is for transforms; anchor is for path alignment.

naming.scope: MDN: offset-distance

definition.zh: offset-distance 指定元素在运动路径上行进到的位置（长度或百分比），动画它即路径驱动运动。
definition.en: offset-distance places the element along the motion path; animating it drives path motion.

distinction.zh: 与 offset-path 的区别：path 定义轨道，distance 是轨道上的进度值。
distinction.en: path is the track; distance is the progress along it.

naming.scope: MDN: offset-position

definition.zh: offset-position 指定运动路径坐标系的原点位置（配合 path() none 时的默认起点）。
definition.en: offset-position sets the origin of the motion path coordinate system.

distinction.zh: 与 offset-anchor 的区别：position 是路径坐标系原点，anchor 是元素上的贴合点。
distinction.en: path origin vs element attachment point.

naming.scope: MDN: offset-rotate

definition.zh: offset-rotate 控制元素沿路径运动时是否随路径方向旋转（auto/auto 45deg/角度）。
definition.en: offset-rotate orients the element to the path direction (auto, auto 45deg, or an angle).

distinction.zh: 与 transform: rotate 的区别：rotate 是固定角度，offset-rotate 是随路径切线变化的朝向。
distinction.en: fixed angle vs tangent-following orientation.

naming.scope: MDN: reading-flow

definition.zh: reading-flow 决定 Tab 焦点与阅读顺序跟随哪种布局顺序（flex-visual、grid-rows 等），使视觉顺序与键盘顺序一致。
definition.en: reading-flow makes Tab order follow the visual layout order (flex-visual, grid-rows).

distinction.zh: 与 tabindex 的区别：tabindex 是逐元素手工指定，reading-flow 是容器级一次声明。
distinction.en: per-element tabindex vs one container-level declaration.

naming.scope: MDN: reading-order

definition.zh: reading-order 在 reading-flow 容器内把某元素提到焦点顺序最前（-1）或恢复默认。
definition.en: reading-order (-1) hoists an element to the front of the flow-based focus order.

distinction.zh: 与 tabindex=-1 的区别：作用于 reading-flow 体系内，与布局顺序联动。
distinction.en: operates within the reading-flow system.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-block

definition.zh: scroll-margin-block 一次设置块向两端的滚动定位外扩。
definition.en: scroll-margin-block sets both block-axis scroll margins.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin-top/bottom 的区别：逻辑版随书写模式。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-bottom

definition.zh: scroll-margin-bottom 设置目标下侧的滚动定位外扩。
definition.en: scroll-margin-bottom sets the bottom scroll margin.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin 速写的区别：单边分项。
distinction.en: per-side longhand.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-inline

definition.zh: scroll-margin-inline 一次设置行向两端的滚动定位外扩。
definition.en: scroll-margin-inline sets both inline-axis scroll margins.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin-left/right 的区别：逻辑版随方向。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-left

definition.zh: scroll-margin-left 设置目标左侧的滚动定位外扩。
