definition.en: scroll-margin-left sets the left scroll margin.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin-inline-start 的区别：物理与逻辑。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-right

definition.zh: scroll-margin-right 设置目标右侧的滚动定位外扩。
definition.en: scroll-margin-right sets the right scroll margin.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin-inline-end 的区别：物理与逻辑。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-top

definition.zh: scroll-margin-top 设置目标上侧的滚动定位外扩，固定头栏下锚点跳转的标准解法。
definition.en: scroll-margin-top is the standard fix for anchor jumps under a sticky header.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding-top 的区别：目标侧与容器侧，两者要一起调才对齐。
distinction.en: target-side vs container-side.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-padding-block

definition.zh: scroll-padding-block 一次设置块向两端的吸附对齐内缩。
definition.en: scroll-padding-block sets both block-axis scroll paddings.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding-top 的区别：逻辑速写 vs 物理分项。
distinction.en: logical shorthand vs physical longhand.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-padding-block-end

definition.zh: scroll-padding-block-end 设置块末侧的吸附对齐内缩。
definition.en: scroll-padding-block-end sets the block-end snap inset.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding-bottom 的区别：逻辑与物理。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-padding-bottom

definition.zh: scroll-padding-bottom 设置下侧的吸附对齐内缩。
definition.en: scroll-padding-bottom sets the bottom snap inset.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin-bottom 的区别：容器侧与目标侧。
distinction.en: container-side vs target-side.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-padding-inline-end

definition.zh: scroll-padding-inline-end 设置行末侧的吸附对齐内缩。
definition.en: scroll-padding-inline-end sets the inline-end snap inset.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding-right 的区别：逻辑与物理。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-padding-left

definition.zh: scroll-padding-left 设置左侧的吸附对齐内缩。
definition.en: scroll-padding-left sets the left snap inset.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding-inline-start 的区别：物理与逻辑。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-padding-right

definition.zh: scroll-padding-right 设置右侧的吸附对齐内缩。
definition.en: scroll-padding-right sets the right snap inset.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding-inline-end 的区别：物理与逻辑。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-snap-stop

definition.zh: scroll-snap-stop: always 强制滚动逐个停在吸附点，禁止快速滑动跳过中间项（轮播翻页常用）。
definition.en: scroll-snap-stop: always forces the scroller to stop at every snap point, preventing skip-through.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-snap-align 的区别：align 决定对齐位置，stop 决定是否必须停靠；分页轮播靠 always。
distinction.en: align sets the position; stop forces landings.

naming.scope: MDN: scrollbar-gutter

definition.zh: scrollbar-gutter 为滚动条预留槽位（stable 强制保留空间），防止滚动条出现/消失时布局抖动。
definition.en: scrollbar-gutter: stable reserves the scrollbar gutter so layout doesn't shift when scrollbars appear.

distinction.zh: 与 overflow 的区别：overflow 决定是否滚动，gutter 决定滚动条空间是否常驻。
distinction.en: overflow decides scrolling; gutter reserves the space.

naming.scope: MDN: overscroll-behavior-block

definition.zh: overscroll-behavior-block 在块向滚动到边界时决定是否把滚动链传导给祖先（contain 阻断、none 还禁止回弹）。
definition.en: overscroll-behavior-block stops scroll chaining at the block-axis boundary (contain; none also kills bounce).

distinction.zh: 与 overscroll-behavior 的区别：按轴拆分的版本；抽屉内滚动到底不带动页面是 contain 的典型用法。
distinction.en: axis-specific variant; contain keeps inner scrolling from scrolling the page.

naming.scope: MDN: overscroll-behavior-inline

definition.zh: overscroll-behavior-inline 在行向滚动到边界时决定滚动链传导。
definition.en: overscroll-behavior-inline governs inline-axis scroll chaining.

distinction.zh: 与 overscroll-behavior-block 的区别：只差轴向。
distinction.en: same semantics, other axis.

naming.scope: MDN: overscroll-behavior-x

definition.zh: overscroll-behavior-x 是横向物理轴的滚动链控制。
definition.en: overscroll-behavior-x is the physical horizontal-axis scroll-chaining control.

distinction.zh: 与 overscroll-behavior-inline 的区别：物理轴与逻辑轴的对应。
distinction.en: physical counterpart of the logical inline variant.

naming.scope: MDN: overscroll-behavior-y

definition.zh: overscroll-behavior-y 是纵向物理轴的滚动链控制，移动端下拉刷新阻断常靠它。
definition.en: overscroll-behavior-y is the vertical physical-axis control; pull-to-refresh blocking uses it.

distinction.zh: 与 overscroll-behavior-block 的区别：物理与逻辑。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-axis-lock

definition.zh: scroll-axis-lock 在斜向滑动开始时锁定滚动轴，避免轻微斜滑同时驱动两轴。
definition.en: scroll-axis-lock locks the scroll axis once a gesture starts so a slightly diagonal swipe drives one axis.

distinction.zh: 与 overscroll-behavior 的区别：overscroll 管边界传导，axis-lock 管手势期间的轴向约束。
distinction.en: boundary chaining vs gesture-axis constraint.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-initial-target

definition.zh: scroll-initial-target 指定页面加载时滚动容器初始应定位到的元素（如跳过顶部横幅）。
definition.en: scroll-initial-target names the element the scroller should land on at load (e.g. skipping a banner).

distinction.zh: 与 scrollIntoView 的区别：声明式、首次加载生效，无需脚本。
distinction.en: declarative initial position, no JS.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-target-group

definition.zh: scroll-target-group 让容器收集其滚动目标并生成可聚焦的组（配合 :target-current 高亮当前项）。
definition.en: scroll-target-group collects the scroller's targets into a focusable group with :target-current highlighting.

distinction.zh: 与手动 scrollspy 脚本的区别：浏览器原生维护当前项状态。
distinction.en: native scrollspy state, no script.

naming.scope: MDN: position

definition.zh: position 决定定位方案：static、relative（原位偏移）、absolute（脱离文档流按包含块）、fixed（相对视口）、sticky（滚动阈值内粘滞）。
definition.en: position picks the positioning scheme: static, relative, absolute, fixed, sticky.

distinction.zh: 与 inset 属性的区别：position 选方案，inset 系列给偏移；sticky 的阈值也由 inset 提供。
distinction.en: position is the scheme; the inset longhands are the offsets.

naming.scope: MDN: float

definition.zh: float 让元素脱离常规流向左/右漂浮，行内内容环绕其排布；现代用途主要是环绕图文与首字下沉。
definition.en: float moves an element aside so inline content wraps around it — mainly for text wrap and drop caps today.

distinction.zh: 与 position:absolute 的区别：float 保留在流内影响兄弟文本环绕，absolute 完全脱流无人环绕。
distinction.en: floats stay in flow (wrap); absolute removes the box from flow.

naming.scope: VisLexicon: layout technique

definition.zh: 清除浮动指利用 clear 或 BFC 包含让被浮动元素撑开的容器恢复高度的经典技巧族（clearfix）。
definition.en: The clearfix family: using clear or a new BFC so containers wrap floated children again.

distinction.zh: 与 clear 属性的区别：clear 是单元素避开浮动，clearfix 是容器级方案（display:flow-root 是现代写法）。
distinction.en: clear avoids floats per element; flow-root is the modern container fix.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-color

definition.zh: border-block-color 一次设置块首/块末两侧边框颜色，随书写模式映射。
definition.en: border-block-color sets both block-side border colors, mapped by writing mode.

distinction.zh: 与 border-color 的区别：只作用块向两侧，行向用 border-inline-color。
distinction.en: block sides only; inline sides use border-inline-color.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-end-color

definition.zh: border-block-end-color 设置块流向末端的边框颜色，横排横写时对应 border-bottom-color，竖排时自动映射到另一侧。
definition.en: border-block-end-color sets the block-end border color.

distinction.zh: 与 border-bottom-color 的区别：逻辑映射 vs 物理固定。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-end-style

definition.zh: border-block-end-style 设置块末侧边框线型（solid/dashed 等）。
definition.en: border-block-end-style sets the block-end border style.

distinction.zh: 与 border-bottom-style 的区别：随书写模式映射。
distinction.en: maps with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-end-width

definition.zh: border-block-end-width 设置块流向末端的边框粗细，横排横写时对应 border-bottom-width。
definition.en: border-block-end-width sets the block-end border thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-bottom-width 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-start-color

definition.zh: border-block-start-color 设置块流向起点的边框颜色，横排横写时对应 border-top-color。
definition.en: border-block-start-color sets the block-start border color.

distinction.zh: 与 border-top-color 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-start-style

definition.zh: border-block-start-style 设置块流向起点的边框线型，横排横写时对应 border-top-style。
definition.en: border-block-start-style sets the block-start border style.

distinction.zh: 与 border-top-style 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-start-width

definition.zh: border-block-start-width 设置块流向起点的边框粗细，横排横写时对应 border-top-width。
definition.en: border-block-start-width sets the block-start border thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-top-width 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-style

definition.zh: border-block-style 一次设置块首/块末两侧边框线型。
definition.en: border-block-style sets both block-side border styles.

distinction.zh: 与 border-style 的区别：仅块向两侧。
distinction.en: block sides only.

naming.scope: MDN: border-block-width

definition.zh: border-block-width 一次设置块首/块末两侧边框粗细。
definition.en: border-block-width sets both block-side border thicknesses.

distinction.zh: 与 border-width 的区别：仅块向两侧。
distinction.en: block sides only.

naming.scope: MDN: border-end-end-radius

definition.zh: border-end-end-radius 用逻辑方向命名圆角：块末+行末交角，横排横写时对应右下圆角。
definition.en: border-end-end-radius names the corner logically (block-end × inline-end; bottom-right in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 border-bottom-right-radius 的区别：逻辑命名随书写模式翻转，物理命名不随。
distinction.en: logical corner naming flips with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: border-end-start-radius

definition.zh: border-end-start-radius 指块末+行首交角圆角，横排横写时对应左下圆角。
definition.en: border-end-start-radius: block-end × inline-start corner (bottom-left in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 border-bottom-left-radius 的区别：逻辑命名随书写模式翻转。
distinction.en: logical naming flips with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline

definition.zh: border-inline 一次设置行首/行末两侧边框（宽/型/色），RTL 自动镜像。
definition.en: border-inline styles both inline-side borders at once, mirroring in RTL.

distinction.zh: 与 border-left/right 的区别：逻辑行向 vs 物理左右。
distinction.en: logical inline vs physical sides.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-color

definition.zh: border-inline-color 一次设置行首/行末两侧边框颜色。
definition.en: border-inline-color sets both inline-side border colors.

distinction.zh: 与 border-left-color/right-color 的区别：随方向镜像。
distinction.en: mirrors with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-end

definition.zh: border-inline-end 是行末侧边框逻辑速写，LTR 时对应 border-right。
definition.en: border-inline-end is the inline-end border shorthand (right in LTR).

distinction.zh: 与 border-right 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-end-color

definition.zh: border-inline-end-color 设置行流向末端的边框颜色，LTR 下对应 border-right-color，RTL 下自动换侧。
definition.en: border-inline-end-color sets the inline-end border color.

distinction.zh: 与 border-right-color 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-end-style

definition.zh: border-inline-end-style 设置行流向末端的边框线型，随书写方向自动换侧。
definition.en: border-inline-end-style sets the inline-end border style.

distinction.zh: 与 border-right-style 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-end-width

definition.zh: border-inline-end-width 设置行流向末端的边框粗细，随书写方向自动换侧。
definition.en: border-inline-end-width sets the inline-end border thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-right-width 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-start

definition.zh: border-inline-start 是行首侧边框逻辑速写，LTR 时对应 border-left；引用条/侧边线标配。
definition.en: border-inline-start is the inline-start border shorthand (left in LTR); the standard quote-bar tool.

distinction.zh: 与 border-left 的区别：RTL 下自动画到另一侧。
distinction.en: auto-mirrors in RTL.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-start-color

definition.zh: border-inline-start-color 设置行流向起点的边框颜色，LTR 下对应 border-left-color。
definition.en: border-inline-start-color sets the inline-start border color.

distinction.zh: 与 border-left-color 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-start-style

definition.zh: border-inline-start-style 设置行流向起点的边框线型，随书写方向自动换侧。
definition.en: border-inline-start-style sets the inline-start border style.

distinction.zh: 与 border-left-style 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-start-width

definition.zh: border-inline-start-width 设置行流向起点的边框粗细，引用条等行首装饰用它最稳。
definition.en: border-inline-start-width sets the inline-start border thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-left-width 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-style

definition.zh: border-inline-style 一次设置行首/行末两侧边框线型。
definition.en: border-inline-style sets both inline-side border styles.

distinction.zh: 与 border-style 的区别：仅行向两侧。
distinction.en: inline sides only.

naming.scope: MDN: border-inline-width

definition.zh: border-inline-width 一次设置行首/行末两侧边框粗细。
definition.en: border-inline-width sets both inline-side border thicknesses.

distinction.zh: 与 border-width 的区别：仅行向两侧。
distinction.en: inline sides only.

naming.scope: MDN: border-left

definition.zh: border-left 是物理左边框速写（宽/型/色）。
definition.en: border-left is the physical left border shorthand.

distinction.zh: 与 border-inline-start 的区别：物理固定 vs 逻辑随方向。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: border-left-color

definition.zh: border-left-color 设置物理左侧边框颜色。
definition.en: border-left-color sets the physical left border color.

distinction.zh: 与 border-inline-start-color 的区别：不随方向翻转。
distinction.en: never flips.

naming.scope: MDN: border-left-style

definition.zh: border-left-style 设置物理左侧边框线型。
definition.en: border-left-style sets the physical left border style.

distinction.zh: 与 border-inline-start-style 的区别：不随方向翻转。
distinction.en: never flips.

naming.scope: MDN: border-left-width

definition.zh: border-left-width 设置物理左侧边框粗细。
definition.en: border-left-width sets the physical left border thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-inline-start-width 的区别：不随方向翻转。
distinction.en: never flips.

naming.scope: MDN: border-right

definition.zh: border-right 是物理右边框速写（宽/型/色）。
definition.en: border-right is the physical right border shorthand.

distinction.zh: 与 border-inline-end 的区别：物理固定 vs 逻辑随方向。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: border-right-color

definition.zh: border-right-color 设置物理右侧边框颜色。
definition.en: border-right-color sets the physical right border color.

distinction.zh: 与 border-inline-end-color 的区别：不随方向翻转。
distinction.en: never flips.

naming.scope: MDN: border-right-style

definition.zh: border-right-style 设置物理右侧边框线型。
definition.en: border-right-style sets the physical right border style.

distinction.zh: 与 border-inline-end-style 的区别：不随方向翻转。
distinction.en: never flips.

naming.scope: MDN: border-right-width

definition.zh: border-right-width 设置物理右侧边框粗细。
definition.en: border-right-width sets the physical right border thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-inline-end-width 的区别：不随方向翻转。
distinction.en: never flips.

naming.scope: MDN: border-spacing

definition.zh: border-spacing 在 border-collapse: separate 时设置相邻单元格边框间距，可给横纵两个值。
definition.en: border-spacing sets the gap between cells when borders are separate; two values = horizontal/vertical.

distinction.zh: 与 border-collapse 的区别：仅在 separate 模式生效。
distinction.en: only applies in separate mode.

naming.scope: MDN: border-start-end-radius

definition.zh: border-start-end-radius 指块首+行末交角圆角，横排横写时对应右上圆角。
definition.en: border-start-end-radius: block-start × inline-end corner (top-right in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 border-top-right-radius 的区别：逻辑命名随书写模式翻转。
distinction.en: logical naming flips with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: border-start-start-radius

definition.zh: border-start-start-radius 指块首+行首交角圆角，横排横写时对应左上圆角。
definition.en: border-start-start-radius: block-start × inline-start corner (top-left in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 border-top-left-radius 的区别：逻辑命名随书写模式翻转。
distinction.en: logical naming flips with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: border-top

definition.zh: border-top 是物理上边框速写（宽/型/色）。
definition.en: border-top is the physical top border shorthand.

distinction.zh: 与 border-block-start 的区别：物理固定 vs 逻辑随书写模式。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: border-top-color

definition.zh: border-top-color 设置物理上侧边框颜色。
definition.en: border-top-color sets the physical top border color.

distinction.zh: 与 border-block-start-color 的区别：不随书写模式。
distinction.en: never flips.

naming.scope: MDN: border-top-style

definition.zh: border-top-style 设置物理上侧边框线型。
definition.en: border-top-style sets the physical top border style.

distinction.zh: 与 border-block-start-style 的区别：不随书写模式。
distinction.en: never flips.

naming.scope: MDN: border-top-width

definition.zh: border-top-width 设置物理上侧边框粗细。
definition.en: border-top-width sets the physical top border thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-block-start-width 的区别：不随书写模式。
distinction.en: never flips.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-block-end-shape

definition.zh: corner-block-end-shape 用 CSS 角形状（squircle、bevel、scoop 等）一次定义块末两侧角的形状。
definition.en: corner-block-end-shape sets the shape of both block-end corners (squircle, bevel, scoop...).

distinction.zh: 与 border-radius 的区别：radius 只能圆弧，corner-shape 族支持超椭圆/斜切/内凹等形状。
distinction.en: radius is arcs only; corner-shape adds squircles, bevels and scoops.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-block-start-shape

definition.zh: corner-block-start-shape 一次定义块首两侧角的形状。
definition.en: corner-block-start-shape sets both block-start corner shapes.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-block-end-shape 的区别：只差块的起止侧。
distinction.en: opposite block side.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-bottom-left-shape

definition.zh: corner-bottom-left-shape 单独定义物理左下角的形状（圆弧之外的 squircle/bevel/scoop/notch）。
definition.en: corner-bottom-left-shape shapes the physical bottom-left corner (beyond plain arcs).

distinction.zh: 与 border-bottom-left-radius 的区别：radius 定弧的大小，shape 定弧/斜切/内凹的形态。
distinction.en: radius sizes the arc; shape picks the form.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-bottom-right-shape

definition.zh: corner-bottom-right-shape 单独定义物理右下角的形状。
definition.en: corner-bottom-right-shape shapes the physical bottom-right corner.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-bottom-left-shape 的区别：只差角位。
distinction.en: other corner.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-bottom-shape

definition.zh: corner-bottom-shape 一次定义下侧两个角的形状。
definition.en: corner-bottom-shape sets both bottom corner shapes.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-*-sh 速写的区别：物理下侧双角。
distinction.en: both physical bottom corners.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-end-end-shape

definition.zh: corner-end-end-shape 用逻辑方向定义块末+行末交角的形状。
definition.en: corner-end-end-shape shapes the block-end × inline-end corner logically.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-bottom-right-shape 的区别：逻辑命名随书写模式翻转。
distinction.en: logical naming flips with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-end-start-shape

definition.zh: corner-end-start-shape 用逻辑方向定义块末+行首交角的形状。
definition.en: corner-end-start-shape shapes the block-end × inline-start corner.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-bottom-left-shape 的区别：逻辑命名。
distinction.en: logical naming.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-inline-end-shape

definition.zh: corner-inline-end-shape 一次定义行末两侧角的形状。
definition.en: corner-inline-end-shape sets both inline-end corner shapes.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-inline-start-shape 的区别：行首/行末之分。
distinction.en: opposite inline side.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-inline-start-shape

definition.zh: corner-inline-start-shape 一次定义行首两侧角的形状。
definition.en: corner-inline-start-shape sets both inline-start corner shapes.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-inline-end-shape 的区别：行首/行末之分。
distinction.en: opposite inline side.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-left-shape

definition.zh: corner-left-shape 一次定义物理左侧两个角的形状。
definition.en: corner-left-shape sets both left corner shapes.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-right-shape 的区别：物理左/右之分。
distinction.en: physical sides.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-right-shape

definition.zh: corner-right-shape 一次定义物理右侧两个角的形状。
definition.en: corner-right-shape sets both right corner shapes.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-left-shape 的区别：物理左/右之分。
distinction.en: physical sides.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-shape

definition.zh: corner-shape 是角形状族的速写，一次给四个角指定 round/squircle/bevel/scoop/notch 等形态。
definition.en: corner-shape is the shorthand giving all four corners a shape: round, squircle, bevel, scoop, notch.

distinction.zh: 与 border-radius 的区别：两者配合使用——radius 定尺寸，corner-shape 定形态；squircle 是 iOS 风格连续圆角。
distinction.en: radius sizes the corner; shape picks its form (squircle = iOS continuous corner).

naming.scope: MDN: corner-start-end-shape

definition.zh: corner-start-end-shape 用逻辑方向定义块首+行末交角的形状。
definition.en: corner-start-end-shape shapes the block-start × inline-end corner.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-top-right-shape 的区别：逻辑命名。
distinction.en: logical naming.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-start-start-shape

definition.zh: corner-start-start-shape 用逻辑方向定义块首+行首交角的形状。
definition.en: corner-start-start-shape shapes the block-start × inline-start corner.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-top-left-shape 的区别：逻辑命名。
distinction.en: logical naming.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-top-left-shape

definition.zh: corner-top-left-shape 单独定义物理左上角的形状。
definition.en: corner-top-left-shape shapes the physical top-left corner.

distinction.zh: 与 border-top-left-radius 的区别：shape 定形态，radius 定尺寸。
distinction.en: shape = form; radius = size.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-top-right-shape

definition.zh: corner-top-right-shape 单独定义物理右上角的形状。
definition.en: corner-top-right-shape shapes the physical top-right corner.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-top-left-shape 的区别：只差角位。
distinction.en: other corner.

naming.scope: MDN: corner-top-shape

definition.zh: corner-top-shape 一次定义上侧两个角的形状。
definition.en: corner-top-shape sets both top corner shapes.

distinction.zh: 与 corner-bottom-shape 的区别：物理上/下之分。
distinction.en: physical sides.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-block

definition.zh: margin-block 一次设置块首/块末两侧外边距，垂直居中常用 margin-block:auto。
definition.en: margin-block sets both block-side margins; auto values center within the block axis.

distinction.zh: 与 margin-top/bottom 的区别：逻辑随书写模式。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-inline-end

definition.zh: margin-inline-end 设置行末侧外边距，RTL 时对应物理左侧。
definition.en: margin-inline-end sets the inline-end margin (right in LTR, left in RTL).

distinction.zh: 与 margin-right 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-inline-start

definition.zh: margin-inline-start 设置行首侧外边距，LTR 时对应物理左侧；一套代码支持 LTR/RTL 的关键替换。
definition.en: margin-inline-start sets the inline-start margin (left in LTR); the key LTR/RTL-safe replacement.

distinction.zh: 与 margin-left 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: margin-trim

definition.zh: margin-trim 让容器裁掉子元素指定侧的外边距（如 block 上），解决“第一个子元素的 margin 撑出空隙”。
definition.en: margin-trim trims children's margins at the container's edges (e.g. block start).

distinction.zh: 与 margin 合并的区别：合并是相邻边距取大，trim 是容器直接剪掉；flex/grid 子项边距的标准解法。
distinction.en: collapsing takes the max; trim removes — the flex/grid child-margin fix.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-block

definition.zh: padding-block 一次设置块首/块末两侧内边距。
definition.en: padding-block sets both block-side paddings.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-top/bottom 的区别：逻辑随书写模式。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-inline

definition.zh: padding-inline 一次设置行首/行末两侧内边距，按钮横向留白的现代写法。
definition.en: padding-inline sets both inline-side paddings — the modern horizontal-inset shorthand.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-left/right 的区别：RTL 自动镜像。
distinction.en: auto-mirrors in RTL.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-inline-end

definition.zh: padding-inline-end 设置行流向末端的内边距，RTL 界面里自动换到物理左侧。
definition.en: padding-inline-end sets the inline-end padding.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-right 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: padding-inline-start

definition.zh: padding-inline-start 设置行流向起点的内边距，列表图标与文字间距用它最稳。
definition.en: padding-inline-start sets the inline-start padding.

distinction.zh: 与 padding-left 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: inset-inline-start

definition.zh: inset-inline-start 设置行流向起点偏移，LTR 时对应 left，RTL 时对应 right。
definition.en: inset-inline-start maps to left in LTR and right in RTL.

distinction.zh: 与 left 的区别：随方向翻转。
distinction.en: flips with direction.

naming.scope: MDN: animation

definition.zh: animation 是动画体系速写，一条声明容纳 name、duration、timing、delay、iteration、direction、fill-mode、play-state、timeline。
definition.en: animation is the shorthand carrying name, duration, timing, delay, iteration count, direction, fill-mode, play-state and timeline.

distinction.zh: 与 transition 的区别：animation 由关键帧驱动可循环可暂停，transition 只在属性值变化时插值一次。
distinction.en: keyframe-driven and loopable vs single interpolation on change.

naming.scope: MDN: background-position-x

definition.zh: background-position-x 单独设置背景横向定位，支持 center/left/right/长度/百分比。
definition.en: background-position-x sets the horizontal background position alone.

distinction.zh: 与 background-position 的区别：position 双轴一次写，x/y 分项可单独动画。
distinction.en: per-axis longhand, individually animatable.

naming.scope: MDN: background-position-y

definition.zh: background-position-y 单独设置背景纵向定位。
definition.en: background-position-y sets the vertical background position alone.

distinction.zh: 与 background-position-x 的区别：只差轴向。
distinction.en: other axis.

naming.scope: MDN: border-bottom-color

definition.zh: border-bottom-color 设置物理下侧边框颜色。
definition.en: border-bottom-color sets the physical bottom border color.

distinction.zh: 与 border-block-end-color 的区别：物理固定 vs 逻辑映射。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: border-bottom-style

definition.zh: border-bottom-style 设置物理下侧边框线型。
definition.en: border-bottom-style sets the physical bottom border style.

distinction.zh: 与 border-block-end-style 的区别：物理固定 vs 逻辑映射。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: border-bottom-width

definition.zh: border-bottom-width 设置物理下侧边框粗细。
definition.en: border-bottom-width sets the physical bottom border thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-block-end-width 的区别：物理固定 vs 逻辑映射。
distinction.en: physical vs logical.

naming.scope: MDN: border-shape

definition.zh: border-shape 用 superellipse()/bevel() 等函数整体定义元素边框轮廓的形状函数。
definition.en: border-shape defines the whole border outline via shape functions like superellipse() and bevel().

distinction.zh: 与 corner-shape 族的区别：corner-* 逐角定义，border-shape 一次性整体定义。
distinction.en: per-corner family vs one whole-outline function.

naming.scope: MDN: break-before

definition.zh: break-before 在元素之前强制或避免分页、分栏、分区域。
definition.en: break-before forces or avoids a page/column/region break before the element.

distinction.zh: 与 break-after 的区别：作用在元素前 vs 后。
distinction.en: before vs after.

naming.scope: MDN: clip (deprecated)

definition.zh: clip 是已废弃的矩形裁切属性，仅支持 rect() 裁切绝对定位元素；被 clip-path 全面取代。
definition.en: The deprecated rect()-only clipper for absolutely positioned elements, fully replaced by clip-path.

distinction.zh: 与 clip-path 的区别：clip 只能切矩形且仅 absolute 定位生效；维护老代码会遇到，新代码一律 clip-path。
distinction.en: rect-only and absolute-only; always clip-path for new work.

naming.scope: MDN: color

definition.zh: color 设置文字及当前色（currentColor）来源，是最基础的前景色属性，会被后代继承。
definition.en: color sets text color and the currentColor source; inherited by descendants.

distinction.zh: 与 background-color 的区别：前景 vs 背景；currentColor 关键字让边框/阴影跟随文字色。
distinction.en: foreground vs background; currentColor follows it.

naming.scope: MDN: color-interpolation-filters

definition.zh: color-interpolation-filters 指定 SVG 滤镜计算用的色彩空间：linearRGB（默认）或 sRGB。
definition.en: color-interpolation-filters picks the filter color space: linearRGB (default) or sRGB.

distinction.zh: 与 filter 的区别：filter 是滤镜本身，本属性决定滤镜运算在哪个色彩空间进行。
distinction.en: the space filters compute in, not the filter itself.

naming.scope: MDN: column-height

definition.zh: column-height 固定多栏布局的栏高，内容超出后按 column-fill 分配。
definition.en: column-height fixes the multicol column height; overflow follows column-fill.

distinction.zh: 与 height 的区别：height 是整个盒子的高度，column-height 是每栏的高度。
distinction.en: box height vs per-column height.

naming.scope: MDN: column-rule

definition.zh: column-rule 是多栏分隔线的速写，一条声明给栏间线设置粗细、线型与颜色，如 column-rule: 1px solid #ddd。
definition.en: column-rule is the inter-column rule shorthand (width/style/color).

distinction.zh: 与 border 速写的区别：画在栏间而非盒边。
distinction.en: between columns, not box edges.

naming.scope: MDN: column-wrap

definition.zh: column-wrap 允许多栏内容在栏高装满后继续开新栏组（wrap），而非溢出或压缩。
definition.en: column-wrap lets multicol content start new column groups instead of overflowing.

distinction.zh: 与 column-fill 的区别：fill 管栏内分配，wrap 管栏组是否换页。
distinction.en: within-column distribution vs new column groups.

naming.scope: MDN: contain-intrinsic-height

definition.zh: contain-intrinsic-height 为 size containment 元素提供物理高度占位估计。
definition.en: contain-intrinsic-height supplies the physical placeholder height for size-contained elements.

distinction.zh: 与 height 的区别：仅在内容被跳过渲染时作为估计值参与，真实内容存在时用实际尺寸。
distinction.en: a stand-in only when rendering is skipped.

naming.scope: MDN: contain-intrinsic-inline-size

definition.zh: contain-intrinsic-inline-size 为 size containment 元素提供行向占位尺寸。
definition.en: contain-intrinsic-inline-size supplies the inline-axis placeholder size.

distinction.zh: 与 contain-intrinsic-width 的区别：逻辑 vs 物理。
distinction.en: logical vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: contain-intrinsic-width

definition.zh: contain-intrinsic-width 为 size containment 元素提供物理宽度占位估计。
definition.en: contain-intrinsic-width supplies the physical placeholder width.

distinction.zh: 与 width 的区别：只在跳过渲染时生效。
distinction.en: active only while rendering is skipped.

naming.scope: MDN: counter-increment

definition.zh: counter-increment 在元素上把命名计数器加一（或指定步长），配合 content: counter() 显示编号。
definition.en: counter-increment bumps a named counter (optional step), displayed via content: counter().

distinction.zh: 与 counter-set 的区别：increment 按步长累加，set 直接钉死当前值。
distinction.en: increment steps; set pins the value.

naming.scope: MDN: counter-reset

definition.zh: counter-reset 把命名计数器归零（或指定初始值），用于章节从 1 重新编号。
definition.en: counter-reset zeroes a counter (or sets its initial value).

distinction.zh: 与 counter-set 的区别：reset 定义起点（通常在容器），set 在序列中改值。
distinction.en: reset declares the start; set rewrites mid-sequence.

naming.scope: MDN: counter-set

definition.zh: counter-set 直接把命名计数器设为指定值。
definition.en: counter-set pins a counter to an explicit value.

distinction.zh: 与 counter-reset 的区别：set 用于序列中途改写（如附录重新从 1 开始）。
distinction.en: mid-sequence rewrite vs start declaration.

naming.scope: MDN: dominant-baseline

definition.zh: dominant-baseline 选择元素自身以哪条基线参与对齐（auto、middle、central、text-after-edge 等），SVG 垂直居中文本的主力属性。
definition.en: dominant-baseline picks which of the element's own baselines aligns (middle, central...); the SVG vertical-centering staple.

distinction.zh: 与 vertical-align: middle 的区别：HTML 行内用 vertical-align 即可，SVG 文本通常需要 dominant-baseline 才能真正垂直居中。
distinction.en: HTML inline uses vertical-align; SVG text needs dominant-baseline.

naming.scope: MDN: empty-cells

definition.zh: empty-cells 控制表格空单元格是否绘制边框与背景（show/hide）。
definition.en: empty-cells shows or hides borders and backgrounds on empty table cells.

distinction.zh: 与 :empty 伪类的区别：:empty 可对任意元素，empty-cells 只作用于表格单元格绘制。
distinction.en: a table-cell paint switch vs the general :empty selector.

naming.scope: MDN: filter

definition.zh: filter 对元素应用图形滤镜函数：blur、brightness、contrast、grayscale、hue-rotate、drop-shadow、saturate、sepia、invert 等。
definition.en: filter applies GPU image functions: blur, brightness, contrast, grayscale, hue-rotate, drop-shadow, saturate, sepia, invert.

distinction.zh: 与 backdrop-filter 的区别：filter 处理元素自身，backdrop-filter 处理元素身后的内容（毛玻璃）。
distinction.en: filter processes the element; backdrop-filter processes what's behind it.

naming.scope: MDN: flex-flow

definition.zh: flex-flow 是 flex-direction 与 flex-wrap 的速写，一条声明决定主轴方向与是否换行。
definition.en: flex-flow combines flex-direction and flex-wrap.

distinction.zh: 与两个分项的区别：只是速写；row wrap 是最常见的 flex-flow: row wrap。
distinction.en: pure shorthand; row wrap is the workhorse.

naming.scope: MDN: flex-line-count

definition.zh: flex-line-count 限制多行弹性容器允许的最大行数（配合溢出处理）。
definition.en: flex-line-count caps how many lines a multi-line flex container may have.

distinction.zh: 与 flex-wrap 的区别：wrap 决定可否换行，line-count 决定最多几行。
distinction.en: wrap enables lines; line-count caps them.

naming.scope: MDN: flex-shrink

definition.zh: flex-shrink 设定空间不足时项目按比例收缩的因子，0 表示拒绝收缩。
definition.en: flex-shrink sets the shrink factor when space is short; 0 refuses to shrink.

distinction.zh: 与 flex-grow 的区别：grow 分配富余，shrink 分摊不足；两者都是相对权重。
distinction.en: grow shares surplus; shrink shares deficit.

naming.scope: MDN: flood-color

definition.zh: flood-color 定义 SVG feFlood 滤镜原语的填充颜色。
definition.en: flood-color sets the color of the feFlood filter primitive.

distinction.zh: 与 lighting-color 的区别：flood 填充整个滤镜区域，lighting 供 feDiffuseLighting 等光照用。
distinction.en: feFlood fill vs lighting filter color.

naming.scope: MDN: flood-opacity

definition.zh: flood-opacity 定义 SVG feFlood 滤镜原语填充层的不透明度，常用于给整块区域铺半透明底色再叠加效果。
definition.en: flood-opacity sets the alpha of the feFlood fill.

distinction.zh: 与 opacity 的区别：只影响滤镜洪水层。
distinction.en: flood layer only.

naming.scope: MDN: font

definition.zh: font 是字体体系速写（style/variant/weight/stretch/size/line-height/family），可同时重置 font 系统属性。
definition.en: font is the typography shorthand (style, variant, weight, stretch, size/line-height, family).

distinction.zh: 与 font-family 单项的区别：速写里 size 和 family 必填，且会重置未写的字体特性。
distinction.en: size and family are required; unwritten longhands reset.

naming.scope: MDN: font-kerning

definition.zh: font-kerning 控制是否使用字体内置的字偶距（auto/normal/none）。
definition.en: font-kerning toggles the font's built-in kerning pairs (auto/normal/none).

distinction.zh: 与 letter-spacing 的区别：kerning 用字体设计好的成对微调，letter-spacing 是统一加间距，两者可叠加。
distinction.en: kerning is pairwise from the font; letter-spacing is uniform.

naming.scope: MDN: font-language-override

definition.zh: font-language-override 强制字体按指定语言系统的字形变体渲染（如让中文文本用简体字形集）。
definition.en: font-language-override forces the font's language-specific glyph set (locl feature).

distinction.zh: 与 :lang() 的区别：:lang 声明语言让浏览器自动选字形，本属性无视标签强制指定。
distinction.en: :lang declares; this overrides regardless of tags.

naming.scope: MDN: font-palette

definition.zh: font-palette 为 COLRv1 彩色字体选择命名调色板或用 base-palette 自定义，一个 SVG 字体文件换肤。
definition.en: font-palette picks a named palette of a COLRv1 color font or builds one via base-palette.

distinction.zh: 与 color 的区别：color 管普通文字色，font-palette 管彩色字体内部的整套颜色。
distinction.en: text color vs the color font's internal palette.

naming.scope: MDN: font-smooth (non-standard)

definition.zh: font-smooth 是非标准属性（-webkit-font-smoothing 等），控制 macOS 上字体的抗锯齿模式。
definition.en: A non-standard property (-webkit-font-smoothing) controlling macOS font antialiasing modes.

distinction.zh: 与 font-weight 的区别：管渲染的平滑算法不是粗细；antialiased 是常见取值。
distinction.en: rendering mode, not weight.

naming.scope: MDN: font-style

definition.zh: font-style 选择正体/斜体（normal/italic）或合成倾斜（oblique 角度）。
definition.en: font-style picks upright/italic or a synthetic oblique angle.

distinction.zh: 与 font-synthesis-style 的区别：本属性声明想要斜体，synthesis 控制字体没有斜体时是否允许浏览器伪造。
distinction.en: requests the style; font-synthesis governs faking it.

naming.scope: MDN: font-synthesis-position

definition.zh: font-synthesis-position 控制浏览器是否允许合成上下标定位（字体缺 baseline 特性时）。
definition.en: font-synthesis-position allows or forbids synthetic sub/superscript positioning.

distinction.zh: 与 font-synthesis 总开关的区别：细分到定位维度。
distinction.en: the position-specific slice of font-synthesis.

naming.scope: MDN: font-synthesis-small-caps

definition.zh: font-synthesis-small-caps 控制字体没有真 smcp 特性时是否允许合成小型大写字母。
definition.en: font-synthesis-small-caps allows synthetic small caps when the font lacks the real feature.

distinction.zh: 与 font-variant-caps 的区别：variant 提出要求，synthesis 决定能否伪造满足。
distinction.en: variant requests; synthesis permits faking.

naming.scope: MDN: font-synthesis-style

definition.zh: font-synthesis-style 控制字体没有 italic 时是否允许合成倾斜。
definition.en: font-synthesis-style allows synthetic italics when the font has none.

distinction.zh: 与 font-style 的区别：style 提要求，synthesis-style 给许可。
distinction.en: request vs permission.

naming.scope: MDN: font-variant

definition.zh: font-variant 是字体变体特性速写（等价 font-variant-caps 等），可用 normal 或各分项值。
definition.en: font-variant is the feature-variant shorthand (small-caps etc.).

distinction.zh: 与 font-feature-settings 的区别：variant 是高层命名特性，feature-settings 是低层四字标签直控。
distinction.en: named high-level features vs raw 4-char tags.

naming.scope: MDN: font-variant-alternates

definition.zh: font-variant-alternates 启用字体的备选字形特性（styleset、swash、ornaments 等开放特性）。
definition.en: font-variant-alternates enables alternate glyph features (styleset, swash, ornaments).

distinction.zh: 与 font-feature-settings 的区别：语义化命名且可被字体作者定义的 styleset 组合。
distinction.en: semantic names including author-defined stylesets.

naming.scope: MDN: font-variant-caps

definition.zh: font-variant-caps 请求小型大写字母等大写变体（small-caps、all-small-caps、titling-caps）。
definition.en: font-variant-caps requests cap variants: small-caps, all-small-caps, titling-caps.

distinction.zh: 与 text-transform: uppercase 的区别：transform 改字符本身，variant 用字体内置的小型大写字形。
distinction.en: transform changes characters; variant uses the font's real glyphs.

naming.scope: MDN: font-variant-east-asian

definition.zh: font-variant-east-asian 控制东亚字形变体（如 jis78、simplified、full-width、ruby 用形）。
definition.en: font-variant-east-asian picks East-Asian glyph variants (jis78, simplified, full-width, ruby forms).

distinction.zh: 与 font-language-override 的区别：east-asian 逐特性选形，language-override 整体换语言集。
distinction.en: per-feature selection vs whole language set.

naming.scope: MDN: font-variant-emoji

definition.zh: font-variant-emoji 请求 emoji 以彩色（unicode）或文本（text）字形渲染。
definition.en: font-variant-emoji requests color (unicode) or text glyph rendering for emoji.

distinction.zh: 与 text-decoration 无关；管的是 emoji 是彩色图还是单色文本形。
distinction.en: color emoji vs monochrome text glyphs.

naming.scope: MDN: font-variant-position

definition.zh: font-variant-position 用字体内置的 sub/super 字形渲染上下标，不用浏览器缩放伪造。
definition.en: font-variant-position uses the font's real sub/super glyphs instead of synthetic scaling.

distinction.zh: 与 <sub>/<sup> 的区别：标签方案缩放+位移合成，variant 用真字形（若字体提供）。
distinction.en: real glyphs vs synthesized scaling.

naming.scope: MDN: font-width

definition.zh: font-width（旧名 font-stretch）选择字体的宽度轴变体，如 condensed、expanded、50%-200%。
definition.en: font-width (formerly font-stretch) picks the width axis: condensed, expanded, 50%-200%.

distinction.zh: 与 letter-spacing 的区别：width 用字体真实的宽度轴字形，spacing 只是加空隙。
distinction.en: real width-axis glyphs vs added spacing.

naming.scope: MDN: frame-sizing (experimental)

definition.zh: frame-sizing 是面向帧式布局的实验属性，按帧单位计算尺寸。
definition.en: An experimental sizing property measuring in frame units for frame-based layouts.

distinction.zh: 与 box-sizing 的区别：改变尺寸的单位语义而非盒模型组成。
distinction.en: changes the unit semantics, not the box model.

naming.scope: MDN: gap

definition.zh: gap 设置 flex/grid/multicol 项目之间的行距与列距，替代旧的 grid-gap/row-gap+column-gap 组合。
definition.en: gap sets row and column gutters between flex/grid/multicol items (formerly grid-gap).

distinction.zh: 与 margin 的区别：gap 只在项目之间产生、不作用于容器边缘，且不参与折叠。
distinction.en: between items only, no container edges, no collapsing.

naming.scope: MDN: grid-auto-columns

definition.zh: grid-auto-columns 定义隐式网格列（超出显式轨道数自动生成的列）的尺寸。
definition.en: grid-auto-columns sizes implicit columns generated beyond the explicit grid.

distinction.zh: 与 grid-template-columns 的区别：template 管显式轨道，auto-* 管自动多出来的轨道。
distinction.en: explicit tracks vs auto-generated ones.

naming.scope: MDN: grid-auto-flow

definition.zh: grid-auto-flow 决定自动放置算法的方向与是否允许填充空洞：row、column、dense。
definition.en: grid-auto-flow picks the auto-placement direction (row/column) and whether to backfill holes (dense).

distinction.zh: 与 dense 的区别：dense 会回填早期空洞，可能打乱视觉顺序，配合 reading-flow 可修焦点顺序。
distinction.en: dense backfills holes (may reorder visually).

naming.scope: MDN: grid-auto-rows

definition.zh: grid-auto-rows 定义隐式网格行的尺寸，卡片瀑布流按内容行高常用 min-content 或 auto。
definition.en: grid-auto-rows sizes implicit rows.

distinction.zh: 与 grid-template-rows 的区别：template 显式声明，auto 管多出来的。
distinction.en: explicit vs implicit tracks.

naming.scope: MDN: grid-column-end

definition.zh: grid-column-end 用网格线编号/名称指定项目在列向的结束位置，与 start 配合定义跨度。
definition.en: grid-column-end names the column line where the item ends.

distinction.zh: 与 span 关键字的区别：span 2 表示跨两列而不关心具体线号。
distinction.en: line-based vs span-based placement.

naming.scope: MDN: column-gap (legacy name)

definition.zh: grid-column-gap 是 column-gap 的旧名，设置网格列间距，规范建议改用 column-gap。
definition.en: The legacy name of column-gap for grid columns.

distinction.zh: 与 column-gap 的区别：同名同义，新代码用 column-gap。
distinction.en: renamed to column-gap.

naming.scope: MDN: grid-column-start

definition.zh: grid-column-start 用网格线指定项目列向起始位置。
definition.en: grid-column-start names the column line where the item starts.

distinction.zh: 与 grid-column 速写的区别：速写一次写 start/end。
distinction.en: longhand of the grid-column shorthand.

naming.scope: MDN: gap (legacy name)

definition.zh: grid-gap 是 gap 的旧名，设置网格行列间距。
definition.en: The legacy name of gap.

distinction.zh: 与 gap 的区别：同名同义，新代码用 gap。
distinction.en: renamed to gap.

naming.scope: MDN: grid-row

definition.zh: grid-row 是 grid-row-start/end 的速写，常用 grid-row: span 2 让卡片占两行。
definition.en: grid-row is the start/end shorthand; span 2 makes a card occupy two rows.

distinction.zh: 与 grid-row-end 单项的区别：速写一次声明两端。
distinction.en: both ends at once.

naming.scope: MDN: grid-row-end

definition.zh: grid-row-end 用网格线指定项目行向结束位置。
definition.en: grid-row-end names the row line where the item ends.

distinction.zh: 与 grid-row-start 配对定义行跨度。
distinction.en: pairs with grid-row-start.

naming.scope: MDN: row-gap (legacy name)

definition.zh: grid-row-gap 是网格行间距的旧名，现规范已更名为 row-gap，老项目代码中仍常见。
definition.en: The legacy name of row-gap.

distinction.zh: 与 row-gap 的区别：更名不更义。
distinction.en: renamed to row-gap.

naming.scope: MDN: grid-row-start

definition.zh: grid-row-start 用网格线指定项目行向起始位置。
definition.en: grid-row-start names the row line where the item starts.

distinction.zh: 与 grid-row 速写的区别：单项。
distinction.en: longhand.

naming.scope: MDN: height

definition.zh: height 设置元素内容盒高度（受 box-sizing 影响），auto 按内容，百分比相对包含块。
definition.en: height sets the content-box height (box-sizing decides inclusion), auto from content, % against the containing block.

distinction.zh: 与 max-height/min-height 的区别：height 是首选值，min/max 是边界；aspect-ratio 可在单维定高时推导另一维。
distinction.en: preferred size vs bounds; aspect-ratio derives the other dimension.

naming.scope: MDN: hyphenate-character

definition.zh: hyphenate-character 自定义断词时行尾使用的连字符字符（默认 U+2010）。
definition.en: hyphenate-character customizes the string shown at line-end hyphenation.

distinction.zh: 与 hyphens 的区别：hyphens 决定是否断词，本属性决定断词符号长什么样。
distinction.en: hyphens enables breaking; this sets the glyph.

naming.scope: MDN: hyphenate-limit-chars

definition.zh: hyphenate-limit-chars 限制断词的最小词长、断点前/后最少字符数，避免碎片化断行。
definition.en: hyphenate-limit-chars sets minimum word length and minimum characters before/after the break.

distinction.zh: 与 hyphens 的区别：hyphens 开关断词，本属性控制断词质量。
distinction.en: the quality dial for hyphenation.

naming.scope: MDN: image-orientation

definition.zh: image-orientation 按 EXIF 信息校正图片朝向，now 规范固定为 from-image。
definition.en: image-orientation applies EXIF orientation; the spec now fixes it to from-image.

distinction.zh: 与 transform: rotate 的区别：orientation 是元数据校正，rotate 是主动旋转。
distinction.en: EXIF correction vs deliberate rotation.

naming.scope: MDN: image-rendering

definition.zh: image-rendering 控制图片缩放插值算法：auto、smooth、crisp-edges、pixelated（像素风必需）。
definition.en: image-rendering picks the scaling algorithm: auto, smooth, crisp-edges, pixelated.

distinction.zh: 与 image-resolution 的区别：rendering 管缩放插值，resolution 管固有 DPI 解释。
distinction.en: interpolation vs DPI interpretation.

naming.scope: MDN: image-resolution

definition.zh: image-resolution 指定 1px CSS 对应图像的固有分辨率（如 1dppx），影响背景图与内容的实际渲染大小。
definition.en: image-resolution declares the image's intrinsic resolution (e.g. 1dppx) affecting rendered size.

distinction.zh: 与 srcset 的区别：srcset 按视口选图，resolution 解释同一张图的 DPI。
distinction.en: source selection vs DPI interpretation.

naming.scope: MDN: ime-mode (deprecated)

definition.zh: ime-mode 是已废弃属性，曾用于控制文本框输入法激活状态（active/inactive/disabled）。
definition.en: The deprecated property that forced IME state on text inputs (active/inactive/disabled).

distinction.zh: 与 inputmode 属性的区别：HTML inputmode 是标准化替代，说明期望的虚拟键盘类型。
distinction.en: HTML inputmode is the standard replacement.

naming.scope: MDN: initial-letter-align

definition.zh: initial-letter-align 指定首字下沉字母与周围文本行的对齐基线（alphabetic、cap-height 等）。
definition.en: initial-letter-align aligns the drop cap against surrounding lines (alphabetic, cap-height).

distinction.zh: 与 initial-letter 的区别：initial-letter 定大小与沉几行，align 定对齐基线。
distinction.en: initial-letter sizes; this aligns.

naming.scope: MDN: inline-size

definition.zh: inline-size 设置行向尺寸（横排时等于 width，竖排时等于 height）。
definition.en: inline-size is the logical width (maps to height in vertical writing).

distinction.zh: 与 width 的区别：随书写模式映射。
distinction.en: maps with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: interactivity

definition.zh: interactivity: inert 让子树整体不可交互（焦点、指针全屏蔽），可用于优化屏外区域。
definition.en: interactivity: inert makes a subtree fully non-interactive (focus and pointer), useful for off-screen regions.

distinction.zh: 与 pointer-events:none 的区别：pointer-events 只挡指针，inert 连焦点和辅助技术一起屏蔽。
distinction.en: pointer-events blocks clicks; inert blocks focus and AT too.

naming.scope: MDN: interest-delay

definition.zh: interest-delay 设置悬停意图（interest invoker，如 hover 弹出）开始与消失的延迟。
definition.en: interest-delay sets the start/end delay for hover-interest invokers (hover popovers).

distinction.zh: 与 transition-delay 的区别：intent 管的是触发意图判定时机，不是过渡时间。
distinction.en: trigger intent timing, not transition timing.

naming.scope: MDN: interest-delay-end

definition.zh: interest-delay-end 设置悬停意图结束（弹出层收起）前的延迟。
definition.en: interest-delay-end delays the dismissal of the hover-invoked UI.

distinction.zh: 与 interest-delay-start 的区别：一进一出两个方向。
distinction.en: show vs hide direction.

naming.scope: MDN: interest-delay-start

definition.zh: interest-delay-start 设置悬停意图触发（弹出层出现）前的延迟。
definition.en: interest-delay-start delays the hover-invoked UI from appearing.

distinction.zh: 与 hover 无延迟弹出的区别：延迟可避免鼠标扫过时的误弹。
distinction.en: avoids drive-by popups.

naming.scope: MDN: justify-content

definition.zh: justify-content 沿主轴分配项目之间的富余空间：flex-start、center、space-between、space-evenly 等。
definition.en: justify-content distributes free space along the main axis (flex-start, center, space-between, space-evenly).

distinction.zh: 与 justify-items 的区别：content 分布的是项目之间，items 对齐的是项目在各自格子里的位置；与 align-content 的区别是轴向。
distinction.en: between-item spacing vs in-cell alignment; axis twin of align-content.

naming.scope: MDN: justify-items

definition.zh: justify-items 设置网格项目在其格子内沿行向的对齐默认值（stretch/center/start/end）。
definition.en: justify-items sets the default inline-axis alignment of grid items inside their cells.

distinction.zh: 与 justify-content 的区别：content 移动轨道整体，items 对齐格子内项目。
distinction.en: tracks vs items-in-cells.

naming.scope: MDN: justify-self

definition.zh: justify-self 覆盖单个网格/弹性项目在行向的自对齐。
definition.en: justify-self overrides one item's inline-axis alignment.

distinction.zh: 与 justify-items 的区别：self 是单项覆盖，items 是容器默认。
distinction.en: per-item override vs container default.

naming.scope: MDN: justify-tracks

definition.zh: justify-tracks 在 masonry 布局中为行向每条轨道单独设置对齐。
definition.en: justify-tracks sets per-track inline-axis alignment in masonry layout.

distinction.zh: 与 justify-content 的区别：逐轨取值列表，masonry 专用。
distinction.en: per-track list, masonry-only.

naming.scope: MDN: letter-spacing

definition.zh: letter-spacing 在每个字符后统一加（或减）间距，大标题常用负值收紧。
definition.en: letter-spacing adds uniform tracking after each character; display type often tracks negative.

distinction.zh: 与 word-spacing 的区别：letter 逐字符，word 逐词；与 font-kerning 的区别：kerning 是字体自带成对微调。
distinction.en: per-character vs per-word; kerning is pairwise from the font.

naming.scope: MDN: lighting-color

definition.zh: lighting-color 定义 feDiffuseLighting/feSpecularLighting 光照滤镜的光源颜色。
definition.en: lighting-color sets the light source color for feDiffuseLighting/feSpecularLighting.

distinction.zh: 与 flood-color 的区别：光照 vs 填充。
distinction.en: lighting vs flood.

naming.scope: MDN: line-break

definition.zh: line-break 控制中日韩文本换行严格度（auto/loose/normal/strict/anywhere）。
definition.en: line-break sets CJK line-breaking strictness (auto, loose, normal, strict, anywhere).

distinction.zh: 与 word-break 的区别：line-break 管标点与禁则的严格程度，word-break 管单词内能否断。
distinction.en: CJK kinsoku strictness vs word-internal breaking.

naming.scope: MDN: line-height

definition.zh: line-height 设置行盒高度，无单位数字按字号倍率继承，是可读性的第一旋钮。
definition.en: line-height sets the line box height; unitless values scale with font-size and inherit robustly.

distinction.zh: 与 font-size 的区别：字号是字形大小，行高是行盒；无单位 1.5 优于 150%（避免继承放大）。
distinction.en: unitless beats percentages for inheritance.

naming.scope: MDN: link-parameters (experimental)

definition.zh: link-parameters 是 MathML 相关的试验属性，用于链接参数化呈现。
definition.en: An experimental MathML-related property for parameterized link rendering.

distinction.zh: 与 HTML <a> 的区别：属于 MathML 生态的试验字段。
distinction.en: MathML ecosystem, experimental.

naming.scope: MDN: list-style

definition.zh: list-style 一次设置列表标记的类型、位置与图像（list-style-type/position/image）。
definition.en: list-style sets the marker type, position and image in one shorthand.

distinction.zh: 与 ::marker 的区别：list-style 配置标记内容与位置，::marker 伪元素定制标记盒样式。
distinction.en: content/position config vs marker-box styling.

naming.scope: MDN: list-style-image

definition.zh: list-style-image 用图像或渐变替代默认列表标记。
definition.en: list-style-image replaces the default marker with an image or gradient.

distinction.zh: 与 list-style-type 的区别：type 用关键字计数符号，image 用图片；image 生效时覆盖 type。
distinction.en: keyword symbols vs an image; image wins.

naming.scope: MDN: list-style-type

definition.zh: list-style-type 选择列表标记符号形态：圆点 disc、十进制 decimal、中文数字 cjk-ideographic，以及 disclosure-open 等控件符号。
definition.en: list-style-type picks the marker: disc, decimal, cjk-ideographic, disclosure-open...

distinction.zh: 与 counters 的区别：type 选符号形态，计数器体系管编号逻辑。
distinction.en: symbol form vs numbering logic.

naming.scope: MDN: marker-mid

definition.zh: marker-mid 指定 SVG 路径中间顶点（非首尾）绘制的标记图形。
definition.en: marker-mid paints a marker at interior vertices of an SVG path.

distinction.zh: 与 marker-start/marker-end 的区别：位置不同；三者都是 marker 属性族。
distinction.en: interior vertices vs endpoints.

naming.scope: MDN: marker-start

definition.zh: marker-start 在 SVG 路径起点绘制标记图形（箭头、圆点）。
definition.en: marker-start paints a marker at the path start.

distinction.zh: 与 marker（简写）的区别：marker 一次设三个位置。
distinction.en: the marker shorthand sets all three positions.

naming.scope: MDN: masonry-auto-flow

definition.zh: masonry-auto-flow 控制 masonry 布局的自动布流策略（按列顺序或按最短列放置）。
definition.en: masonry-auto-flow picks the masonry placement strategy (ordered columns vs shortest column).

distinction.zh: 与 grid-auto-flow 的区别：masonry 版本的布流开关。
distinction.en: the masonry version of auto-flow.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-border

definition.zh: mask-border 用一张图按九宫格切片遮罩元素边框区域（对应 border-image 的遮罩版）。
definition.en: mask-border masks the border area with a sliced image (the mask counterpart of border-image).

distinction.zh: 与 border-image 的区别：border-image 画边框图，mask-border 用图决定边框区可见性。
distinction.en: paints vs masks the border area.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-border-mode

definition.zh: mask-border-mode 指定遮罩边框图按 alpha 还是亮度（luminance）解释。
definition.en: mask-border-mode interprets the border mask by alpha or luminance.

distinction.zh: 与 mask-mode 的区别：作用于边框切片而非整幅遮罩。
distinction.en: border slices vs the whole mask.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-border-outset

definition.zh: mask-border-outset 让遮罩边框切片向盒外偏移。
definition.en: mask-border-outset offsets the border mask slices outward.

distinction.zh: 与 border-image-outset 的区别：作用于遮罩切片。
distinction.en: mask slices, not painted image.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-border-repeat

definition.zh: mask-border-repeat 控制遮罩边框切片的填充方式（stretch/repeat/round/space）。
definition.en: mask-border-repeat fills the border mask regions (stretch/repeat/round/space).

distinction.zh: 与 border-image-repeat 的区别：遮罩语义。
distinction.en: masking, not painting.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-border-slice

definition.zh: mask-border-slice 把遮罩图切成九宫格用于边框区。
definition.en: mask-border-slice cuts the mask image into a 3x3 grid for the border area.

distinction.zh: 与 border-image-slice 的区别：切的是遮罩图。
distinction.en: slices the mask image.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-border-source

definition.zh: mask-border-source 指定用作边框遮罩的图像。
definition.en: mask-border-source sets the border mask image.

distinction.zh: 与 border-image-source 的区别：决定可见性而非绘制。
distinction.en: visibility, not paint.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-border-width

definition.zh: mask-border-width 设定边框遮罩区的厚度。
definition.en: mask-border-width sets the border mask area thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-image-width 的区别：遮罩语义。
distinction.en: mask semantics.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-clip

definition.zh: mask-clip 限定每层遮罩影响到的盒子区域（border-box/content-box 等）。
definition.en: mask-clip confines each mask layer to a box region.

distinction.zh: 与 background-clip 的区别：管遮罩层的作用范围而不是背景绘制。
distinction.en: mask-layer extent vs background paint extent.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-origin

definition.zh: mask-origin 设置遮罩层定位坐标系原点盒。
definition.en: mask-origin sets the mask layer's positioning origin box.

distinction.zh: 与 background-origin 的区别：遮罩层语义。
distinction.en: mask semantics.

naming.scope: MDN: mask-type

definition.zh: mask-type 指定 SVG <mask> 元素按 alpha 通道还是亮度（luminance）解释遮罩，亮度模式适合黑白图当遮罩。
definition.en: mask-type interprets an SVG <mask> by luminance or alpha.

distinction.zh: 与 mask-mode 的区别：mask-type 设在 <mask> 元素上，mask-mode 设在使用者元素上。
distinction.en: set on the <mask> element vs the consumer.

naming.scope: MDN: math-depth

definition.zh: math-depth 记录元素在 MathML 公式树中的深度，配合 math-style 控制紧凑度。
definition.en: math-depth tracks nesting depth in MathML formulas, paired with math-style for compactness.

distinction.zh: 与 DOM 深度的区别：只按 MathML 语义计数。
distinction.en: MathML-semantic depth only.

naming.scope: MDN: math-shift

definition.zh: math-shift 控制 MathML 上下标使用紧凑（compact）还是正常（normal）样式。
definition.en: math-shift picks compact vs normal sub/superscript styling in MathML.

distinction.zh: 与 font-variant-position 的区别：MathML 专用。
distinction.en: MathML-specific.

naming.scope: MDN: math-style

definition.zh: math-style 控制MathML公式以紧凑（compact）还是正常高度渲染。
definition.en: math-style renders MathML formulas compact or normal height.

distinction.zh: 与 line-height 的区别：MathML 语义的紧凑度。
distinction.en: MathML semantics.

naming.scope: MDN: max-block-size

definition.zh: max-block-size 限制块向尺寸上限（横排时等于 max-height）。
definition.en: max-block-size caps the block-axis size (max-height in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 max-height 的区别：随书写模式映射。
distinction.en: maps with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: max-lines

definition.zh: max-lines（配合 block-ellipsis）在行数钳制容器中限制可见行数并生成省略提示。
definition.en: max-lines caps visible lines in a line-clamp container, with block-ellipsis for the hint.

distinction.zh: 与 -webkit-line-clamp 的区别：max-lines 是标准化提案，配合 line-clamp 属性族。
distinction.en: the standardized line-clamp family member.

naming.scope: MDN: min-inline-size

definition.zh: min-inline-size 设置行向尺寸下限（横排时等于 min-width）。
definition.en: min-inline-size floors the inline-axis size (min-width in horizontal-tb).

distinction.zh: 与 min-width 的区别：随书写模式映射。
distinction.en: maps with writing mode.

naming.scope: MDN: mix-blend-mode

definition.zh: mix-blend-mode 决定元素与其背后内容如何合成（multiply、screen、overlay、difference 等），difference 反色效果即来源于此。
definition.en: mix-blend-mode composites the element with its backdrop (multiply, screen, overlay, difference...).

distinction.zh: 与 background-blend-mode 的区别：mix 是元素与背景合成，background 版只在自身背景层间混合；与 isolation 的区别：isolation 可截断混合范围。
distinction.en: element-vs-backdrop compositing; isolation scopes it.

naming.scope: MDN: object-view-box

definition.zh: object-view-box 在替换元素（图片/视频）上声明一个视窗矩形，只显示其局部，配合缩放实现图内取景。
definition.en: object-view-box declares a view rectangle over replaced content, showing only that region.

distinction.zh: 与 object-fit 的区别：fit 管整图适配，view-box 从图中开窗取景。
distinction.en: whole-image fit vs an in-image window.

naming.scope: MDN: opacity

definition.zh: opacity 设置元素整体不透明度（0–1），小于 1 会创建新的层叠上下文并影响合成性能。
definition.en: opacity sets overall element alpha (0-1); below 1 it creates a stacking context.

distinction.zh: 与 rgba 颜色的区别：opacity 连同子内容一起变透明，rgba 只影响该颜色自身。
distinction.en: opacity fades the whole subtree; rgba fades one color.

naming.scope: MDN: orphans

definition.zh: orphans 规定块在分页/分栏时段落顶部最少保留的行数。
definition.en: orphans sets the minimum lines kept at the top of a fragment.

distinction.zh: 与 widows 的区别：orphans 管段首，widows 管段尾。
distinction.en: top of fragment vs bottom.

naming.scope: MDN: outline-style

definition.zh: outline-style 设置轮廓线型（solid/dashed/auto 等），auto 值由平台提供焦点环。
definition.en: outline-style sets the outline style; auto is the platform focus ring.

distinction.zh: 与 border-style 的区别：outline 不占布局、可溢出盒外，是键盘焦点可见性的标准载体。
distinction.en: outlines take no layout space; the standard focus indicator.

naming.scope: MDN: outline-width

definition.zh: outline-width 设置轮廓线粗细，与 border-width 不同的是轮廓不占布局空间、可画在盒外。
definition.en: outline-width sets the outline thickness.

distinction.zh: 与 border-width 的区别：不占布局空间。
distinction.en: no layout impact.

naming.scope: MDN: overflow

definition.zh: overflow 决定内容超出盒子的处理：visible、hidden（裁切）、clip（严格裁切且不可滚动）、scroll、auto。
definition.en: overflow handles content exceeding the box: visible, hidden, clip (strict, unscrollable), scroll, auto.

distinction.zh: 与 overflow-clip-margin 的区别：clip 模式下 clip-margin 扩大裁切余量；与 text-overflow 的区别：text-overflow 只是显示省略符号。
distinction.en: clip is strict and unscrollable; clip-margin widens it.

naming.scope: MDN: overflow-block

definition.zh: overflow-block 是块向溢出处理的逻辑属性版。
definition.en: overflow-block is the logical block-axis overflow control.

distinction.zh: 与 overflow-y 的区别：逻辑轴随书写模式。
distinction.en: logical axis vs physical.

naming.scope: MDN: overflow-clip-box (experimental)

definition.zh: overflow-clip-box 是试验属性，为 padding-box/content-box 提供独立裁切盒选择。
definition.en: An experimental property choosing which box (padding/content) serves as the clip box.

distinction.zh: 与 overflow: clip 的区别：细化裁切盒的选择。
distinction.en: refines clip-box choice.

naming.scope: MDN: overflow-wrap

definition.zh: overflow-wrap（旧名 word-wrap）允许在单词内部断行以防溢出：break-word 会在必要时断开长词。
definition.en: overflow-wrap (formerly word-wrap) breaks inside words to prevent overflow (break-word).

distinction.zh: 与 word-break 的区别：overflow-wrap 只在放不下时才断，word-break: break-all 则无条件按字符断。
distinction.en: only when needed vs unconditional per-character breaking.

naming.scope: MDN: overflow-y

definition.zh: overflow-y 单独控制纵向溢出：hidden 裁切、auto 按需出现滚动条、scroll 常驻滚动条。
definition.en: overflow-y controls vertical overflow alone.

distinction.zh: 与 overflow 速写的区别：单轴；x/y 组合不同值时 scroll 会彼此传染为 auto 的行为要注意。
distinction.en: per-axis; mixed values have interplay quirks.

naming.scope: MDN: page

definition.zh: page 把元素指定到命名 @page 规则，实现不同章节不同纸张设置。
definition.en: page assigns elements to a named @page rule for per-chapter paper settings.

distinction.zh: 与 page-break-* 的区别：page 选页型，break-* 控制断页时机。
distinction.en: paper type vs break timing.

naming.scope: MDN: page-break-after (legacy)

definition.zh: page-break-after 是 break-after 的打印旧名，在元素后强制/避免分页。
definition.en: The legacy print name of break-after.

distinction.zh: 与 break-after 的区别：旧名仍广泛支持，新代码用 break-after。
distinction.en: legacy alias.

naming.scope: MDN: page-break-before (legacy)

definition.zh: page-break-before 在元素之前控制分页（always 强制、avoid 避免），是 break-before 的打印旧名，打印样式仍常用。
definition.en: The legacy print name of break-before.

distinction.zh: 与 break-before 的区别：旧名。
distinction.en: legacy alias.

naming.scope: MDN: page-break-inside (legacy)

definition.zh: page-break-inside 是 break-inside 的打印旧名，avoid 值防止元素内部断页。
definition.en: The legacy print name of break-inside; avoid keeps the element unbroken.

distinction.zh: 与 break-inside 的区别：旧名。
distinction.en: legacy alias.

naming.scope: MDN: paint-order

definition.zh: paint-order 控制文字描边与填充、SVG 标记的绘制先后，文字描边描边后置填充可避免描边吃掉字形。
definition.en: paint-order orders fill/stroke/markers painting; stroke-behind-fill keeps text outlines from eating glyphs.

distinction.zh: 与 stroke 的区别：stroke 定义描边，paint-order 决定它与填充谁先画。
distinction.en: defines the stroke; paint-order sequences it.

naming.scope: SVG: path/path-length

definition.zh: path-length 是 SVG path 元素属性，把路径总长归一化为指定值，使 stroke-dasharray 动画与路径真实长度无关。
definition.en: An SVG path attribute normalizing total length so dash animations are length-agnostic.

distinction.zh: 与 stroke-dasharray 的区别：dasharray 用长度画虚线，path-length 重定义总长。
distinction.en: dash pattern vs length normalization.

naming.scope: MDN: place-content

definition.zh: place-content 是 align-content 与 justify-content 的速写，一个值同时设两轴分布。
definition.en: place-content is the shorthand for align-content + justify-content.

distinction.zh: 与 place-items 的区别：content 移轨道/行组，items 对齐格内项目。
distinction.en: tracks vs items.

naming.scope: MDN: place-items

definition.zh: place-items 是 align-items 与 justify-items 的速写，grid 子项居中常用 place-items:center。
definition.en: place-items combines align-items + justify-items; center-center is the grid workhorse.

distinction.zh: 与 place-content 的区别：items 管格内项目。
distinction.en: items-in-cells.

naming.scope: MDN: place-self

definition.zh: place-self 是 align-self 与 justify-self 的速写，单个项目全居中写 place-self:center。
definition.en: place-self combines align-self + justify-self for a single item.

distinction.zh: 与 place-items 的区别：self 作用于单个项目。
distinction.en: single item.

naming.scope: MDN: print-color-adjust

definition.zh: print-color-adjust: exact-economy 要求打印时精确保留元素颜色（不被浏览器省墨替换）。
definition.en: print-color-adjust: exact keeps exact colors in print instead of the browser's ink-saving adjustments.

distinction.zh: 与 color 的区别：不管颜色值，只管打印时是否原样输出。
distinction.en: fidelity policy, not a color value.

naming.scope: MDN: row-gap

definition.zh: row-gap 设置多行 flex/grid/多栏的行间距。
definition.en: row-gap sets the gutter between rows.

distinction.zh: 与 column-gap 的区别：只差轴向；gap 速写一次给两轴。
distinction.en: axis twin of column-gap.

naming.scope: MDN: box-align (legacy)

definition.zh: box-align 是 2009 旧版弹性盒规范的交叉轴对齐属性，仅老 WebKit 支持，对应现代 align-items。
definition.en: The 2009 flexbox cross-axis alignment property (legacy WebKit), superseded by align-items.

distinction.zh: 与 align-items 的区别：规范已废弃，见到 box-* 属性应改写为现代 flex 对应物。
distinction.en: deprecated; map to modern flexbox equivalents.

naming.scope: MDN: box-direction (legacy)

definition.zh: box-direction 是 2009 旧弹性盒的主轴方向属性（normal/reverse），被 flex-direction 取代。
definition.en: The 2009 flexbox main-axis direction property, replaced by flex-direction.

distinction.zh: 与 flex-direction 的区别：废弃规范；reverse 语义相同。
distinction.en: deprecated spec; flex-direction is the replacement.

naming.scope: MDN: box-flex (legacy)

definition.zh: box-flex 是 2009 旧弹性盒的伸缩因子（0 或非 0），被 flex-grow/shrink 组合取代。
definition.en: The 2009 flexbox flexibility factor, replaced by flex-grow/shrink.

distinction.zh: 与 flex 的区别：box-flex 只有 0/非 0 两态语义。
distinction.en: binary semantics vs graded flex.

naming.scope: MDN: box-flex-group (legacy)

definition.zh: box-flex-group 把 2009 旧弹性盒子项分组按序分配剩余空间，已废弃。
definition.en: Groups legacy flexbox children for sequential space distribution; deprecated.

distinction.zh: 与现代 flex 的区别：现代规范无分组概念。
distinction.en: no modern equivalent.

naming.scope: MDN: box-lines (legacy)

definition.zh: box-lines 是 2009 旧弹性盒的换行开关（single/multiple），被 flex-wrap 取代。
definition.en: The 2009 flexbox wrap switch (single/multiple), replaced by flex-wrap.

distinction.zh: 与 flex-wrap 的区别：废弃；语义对应 wrap/nowrap。
distinction.en: deprecated; maps to wrap/nowrap.

naming.scope: MDN: box-ordinal-group (legacy)

definition.zh: box-ordinal-group 是 2009 旧弹性盒的视觉排序属性，被 order 取代。
definition.en: The 2009 flexbox visual ordering property, replaced by order.

distinction.zh: 与 order 的区别：语义对应，规范不同。
distinction.en: same idea, dead spec.

naming.scope: MDN: box-orient (legacy)

definition.zh: box-orient 是 2009 旧弹性盒的轴向属性（horizontal/vertical），被 flex-direction 取代。
definition.en: The 2009 flexbox axis property (horizontal/vertical), replaced by flex-direction.

distinction.zh: 与 flex-direction 的区别：废弃规范。
distinction.en: dead spec.

naming.scope: MDN: box-pack (legacy)

definition.zh: box-pack 是 2009 旧弹性盒的主轴分布属性（start/center/end/justify），被 justify-content 取代。
definition.en: The 2009 flexbox main-axis distribution property, replaced by justify-content.

distinction.zh: 与 justify-content 的区别：废弃；justify 对应 space-between。
distinction.en: deprecated; justify maps to space-between.

naming.scope: MDN: ruby-align

definition.zh: ruby-align 控制 <ruby> 注音文本与正文的对齐分配（start、space-between、space-around 等）。
definition.en: ruby-align distributes ruby annotation text against the base text (start, space-between...).

distinction.zh: 与 text-align 的区别：专用于注音/注解排版（<rt>）。
distinction.en: ruby-annotation specific.

naming.scope: MDN: ruby-merge

definition.zh: ruby-merge 控制连续注音是否合并成一段整体对齐（auto/merge）。
definition.en: ruby-merge merges consecutive ruby annotations into one run (auto/merge).

distinction.zh: 与 ruby-align 的区别：merge 管注音是否连成一段，align 管对齐方式。
distinction.en: merging vs distribution.

naming.scope: MDN: ruby-overhang

definition.zh: ruby-overhang 控制注音是否允许悬挂到相邻文字上方以压缩间距。
definition.en: ruby-overhang lets annotations hang over neighboring characters to compress spacing.

distinction.zh: 与 ruby-position 的区别：overhang 管横向悬挂策略，position 管注音在字上方/下方。
distinction.en: horizontal overhang vs above/below placement.

naming.scope: MDN: ruby-position

definition.zh: ruby-position 把注音文本放在正文上方（over）或下方（under），日文ルビ排版的开关。
definition.en: ruby-position places annotations above (over) or below (under) the base text.

distinction.zh: 与 ruby-overhang 的区别：上下位置 vs 横向悬挂。
distinction.en: vertical placement vs horizontal hang.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-block-end

definition.zh: scroll-margin-block-end 设置滚动定位目标块末侧的外扩。
definition.en: scroll-margin-block-end sets the block-end scroll margin.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin-bottom 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-block-start

definition.zh: scroll-margin-block-start 设置滚动定位目标块首侧的外扩。
definition.en: scroll-margin-block-start sets the block-start scroll margin.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin-top 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-inline-end

definition.zh: scroll-margin-inline-end 设置滚动定位目标行末侧的外扩。
definition.en: scroll-margin-inline-end sets the inline-end scroll margin.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin-right 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-margin-inline-start

definition.zh: scroll-margin-inline-start 设置滚动定位目标行首侧的外扩。
definition.en: scroll-margin-inline-start sets the inline-start scroll margin.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-margin-left 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-padding-block-start

definition.zh: scroll-padding-block-start 设置吸附对齐区块首侧内缩。
definition.en: scroll-padding-block-start insets the snap alignment area at block start.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding-top 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-padding-inline-start

definition.zh: scroll-padding-inline-start 设置吸附对齐区行首侧内缩。
definition.en: scroll-padding-inline-start insets the snap area at inline start.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding-left 的区别：逻辑映射。
distinction.en: logical mapping.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-snap-coordinate (legacy)

definition.zh: scroll-snap-coordinate 是 2015 前旧吸附规范的元素侧吸附点属性，已被 scroll-snap-align 取代。
definition.en: The element-side snap point of the pre-2015 snap spec, replaced by scroll-snap-align.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-snap-align 的区别：旧规范以坐标定义，新规范以 start/center/end 对齐。
distinction.en: coordinate-based old spec vs alignment-based new spec.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-snap-destination (legacy)

definition.zh: scroll-snap-destination 是旧吸附规范容器侧的吸附目标点，已被 scroll-padding + snap-align 体系取代。
definition.en: The container-side snap destination of the old spec, replaced by scroll-padding + snap-align.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-padding 的区别：旧坐标体系 vs 新内缩体系。
distinction.en: old coordinate system vs new padding system.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-snap-points-x (legacy)

definition.zh: scroll-snap-points-x 是旧 IE 吸附规范的容器横向吸附点列（repeat(100px)），仅 IE/旧 Edge 支持。
definition.en: The IE-era container snap-point list for horizontal scrolling (repeat(100px)).

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-snap-type 的区别：旧规范在容器上列点，新规范在元素上对齐。
distinction.en: container point-lists vs element alignment.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-snap-points-y (legacy)

definition.zh: scroll-snap-points-y 是旧 IE 吸附规范的容器纵向吸附点列。
definition.en: The IE-era vertical snap-point list.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-snap-points-x 的区别：只差轴向。
distinction.en: other axis.

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-timeline-axis

definition.zh: scroll-timeline-axis 指定具名滚动时间线读取哪个轴的滚动进度（block/inline/x/y）。
definition.en: scroll-timeline-axis picks which scroll axis feeds the named timeline (block/inline/x/y).

distinction.zh: 与 animation-timeline: scroll(...) 的区别：匿名 scroll() 内联指定轴，本属性配合 scroll-timeline-name 在容器上声明。
distinction.en: named-timeline container declaration vs inline scroll().

naming.scope: MDN: scroll-timeline-name

definition.zh: scroll-timeline-name 给滚动容器的时间线命名，供后代元素的 animation-timeline 引用。
definition.en: scroll-timeline-name names the scroller's timeline for descendants' animation-timeline.

distinction.zh: 与 view-timeline-name 的区别：scroll 版跟随容器滚动量，view 版跟随元素进入视口的进度。
distinction.en: scroll progress vs in-view progress.

naming.scope: MDN: speak-as

definition.zh: speak-as 指定语音合成朗读文本的方式（normal/spell-out/digits/literal-punctuation/no-punctuation）。
definition.en: speak-as directs speech synthesis: normal, spell-out, digits, punctuation handling.

distinction.zh: 与 aria-label 的区别：speak-as 控制同一文本的朗读风格，aria-label 替换朗读内容。
distinction.en: reading style vs content replacement.

naming.scope: MDN: stop-color

definition.zh: stop-color 设置 SVG 渐变 <stop> 停靠点的颜色。
definition.en: stop-color sets the color of an SVG gradient <stop>.

distinction.zh: 与 fill 的区别：作用于渐变停靠点而不是形状填充。
distinction.en: gradient stops, not shape fill.

naming.scope: MDN: stop-opacity

definition.zh: stop-opacity 设置 SVG 渐变停靠点的透明度，渐隐渐变靠它。
definition.en: stop-opacity sets a gradient stop's alpha; fade-out gradients rely on it.

distinction.zh: 与 fill-opacity 的区别：停靠点级 vs 形状级。
distinction.en: per-stop vs per-shape.

naming.scope: MDN: stroke-color

definition.zh: stroke-color 是 CSS 化的 SVG 描边颜色属性（等价 presentation attribute stroke）。
definition.en: stroke-color is the CSS-side stroke color (equivalent to the stroke attribute).

distinction.zh: 与 color 的区别：描边色 vs 前景色。
distinction.en: stroke vs foreground.

naming.scope: MDN: stroke-linecap

definition.zh: stroke-linecap 定义描边线段端点形状：butt（平头）、round（圆头）、square（方头），线宽只是绘制参数时它决定端点观感。
definition.en: stroke-linecap shapes stroke ends: butt, round, square.

distinction.zh: 与 stroke-linejoin 的区别：linecap 管端点，linejoin 管拐角。
distinction.en: endpoints vs joints.

naming.scope: MDN: stroke-opacity

definition.zh: stroke-opacity 设置 SVG 描边层的不透明度，做半透明描边叠加时与 fill-opacity 分别控制两层。
definition.en: stroke-opacity sets stroke alpha.

distinction.zh: 与 fill-opacity 的区别：描边层 vs 填充层。
distinction.en: stroke layer vs fill layer.

naming.scope: MDN: tab-size

definition.zh: tab-size 设置制表符渲染宽度（空格数或长度），代码展示块标配。
definition.en: tab-size sets the tab character's rendered width (spaces or length).

distinction.zh: 与 white-space 的区别：tab-size 只在 pre 等保留空白时可见。
distinction.en: visible only where whitespace is preserved.

naming.scope: MDN: table-layout

definition.zh: table-layout 选 fixed（按首行/声明宽度定列，快）或 auto（按内容计算，慢）。
definition.en: table-layout picks fixed (first-row widths, fast) or auto (content-based, slow).

distinction.zh: 与 width 的区别：fixed 算法下单元格 width 生效于整列。
distinction.en: under fixed, cell widths drive whole columns.

naming.scope: MDN: text-align

definition.zh: text-align 对齐块内行内内容：left/right 物理对齐、center 居中、justify 两端对齐、start/end 逻辑对齐随书写方向。
definition.en: text-align aligns inline content: left, right, center, justify, start, end.

distinction.zh: 与 text-align-last 的区别：后者管 justify 段落的最后一行。
distinction.en: last line handled by text-align-last.

naming.scope: MDN: text-align-last

definition.zh: text-align-last 控制块状文本最后一行（或 justify 段落末行）的对齐方式。
definition.en: text-align-last aligns the last line of a block (or of justified paragraphs).

distinction.zh: 与 text-align 的区别：只作用于末行。
distinction.en: last line only.

naming.scope: MDN: text-anchor

definition.zh: text-anchor 决定 SVG 文本相对 x 坐标的对齐：start、middle、end。
definition.en: text-anchor aligns SVG text to its x coordinate: start, middle, end.

distinction.zh: 与 text-align 的区别：锚定到坐标点而不是盒子。
distinction.en: anchors to a point, not a box.

naming.scope: MDN: text-combine-upright

definition.zh: text-combine-upright 在竖排文本里把一小组字符（如两位数字）合并横排到一个字位（tate-chu-yoko）。
definition.en: text-combine-upright fits a short run (like a 2-digit number) into one upright column cell (tate-chu-yoko).

distinction.zh: 与 writing-mode 的区别：writing-mode 转全篇方向，本属性只合并局部字符。
distinction.en: whole-flow direction vs a local character merge.

naming.scope: MDN: text-decoration-color

definition.zh: text-decoration-color 单独设置下划线/删除线等装饰线的颜色。
definition.en: text-decoration-color sets the color of underlines and line-throughs.

distinction.zh: 与 text-decoration 速写的区别：分项，可让装饰线与文字异色。
distinction.en: lets the line differ from the text color.

naming.scope: MDN: text-decoration-inset

definition.zh: text-decoration-inset 让装饰线两端向内收缩指定距离，避免贴到标点。
definition.en: text-decoration-inset shrinks the decoration line inward at its ends.

distinction.zh: 与 text-decoration-skip 的区别：inset 按距离收缩，skip 按字符类型跳过。
distinction.en: distance-based vs glyph-based skipping.

naming.scope: MDN: text-decoration-skip

definition.zh: text-decoration-skip 控制装饰线跳过哪些内容（空格、 descender、inset 等，旧草案属性）。
definition.en: text-decoration-skip controls what the line skips (spaces, ink, edges) — the older draft property.

distinction.zh: 与 text-decoration-skip-ink 的区别：skip 是旧草案全量开关，skip-ink 只管字形穿越。
distinction.en: the old full-featured draft vs the standardized skip-ink.

naming.scope: MDN: text-decoration-thickness

definition.zh: text-decoration-thickness 显式设置装饰线粗细（auto/from-font/长度）。
definition.en: text-decoration-thickness sets the line thickness (auto, from-font, length).

distinction.zh: 与 border-bottom 模拟下划线的区别：decoration 跟随字形与换行，border 是盒级横线。
distinction.en: follows glyphs and wraps; borders draw at the box.

naming.scope: MDN: text-emphasis-color

definition.zh: text-emphasis-color 单独设置着重号的颜色，常与 text-emphasis-style 组合成品牌色着重标记。
definition.en: text-emphasis-color colors the emphasis marks.

distinction.zh: 与 color 的区别：只管着重号。
distinction.en: marks only.

naming.scope: MDN: text-emphasis-position

definition.zh: text-emphasis-position 把着重号放到文字上方/下方、右侧/左侧（随横竖排）。
definition.en: text-emphasis-position places emphasis marks over/under and right/left.

distinction.zh: 与 text-emphasis 速写的区别：position 是位置分项。
distinction.en: position longhand.

naming.scope: MDN: text-emphasis-style

definition.zh: text-emphasis-style 选择着重号形态：dot、circle、double-circle、triangle、sesame 或自定义字符。
definition.en: text-emphasis-style picks the mark: dot, circle, double-circle, triangle, sesame or a custom string.

distinction.zh: 与 text-decoration 的区别：着重号紧贴字形旁边，装饰线是贯穿线。
distinction.en: beside-glyph marks vs crossing lines.

naming.scope: MDN: text-orientation

definition.zh: text-orientation 控制竖排文本中字符朝向：mixed（拉丁旋转/汉字直立）、upright（全直立）、sideways。
definition.en: text-orientation sets glyph orientation in vertical writing: mixed, upright, sideways.

distinction.zh: 与 writing-mode 的区别：writing-mode 决定竖排本身，orientation 决定竖排里字符怎么站。
distinction.en: writing-mode turns the flow; orientation turns the glyphs.

naming.scope: MDN: text-transform

definition.zh: text-transform 做呈现层的大小写转换：uppercase、lowercase、capitalize、full-width。
definition.en: text-transform case-converts at render time: uppercase, lowercase, capitalize, full-width.

distinction.zh: 与 font-variant-caps 的区别：transform 改字符本身（真实大写字母），variant 用字体内置变体字形。
distinction.en: real characters vs font variant glyphs.

naming.scope: MDN: text-underline-offset

definition.zh: text-underline-offset 把下划线从默认位置抬离/压近字形（auto 或长度）。
definition.en: text-underline-offset moves the underline away from or closer to the glyphs.

distinction.zh: 与 text-decoration-thickness 的区别：一个管位置一个管粗细，链接样式黄金搭档。
distinction.en: offset vs thickness — the link-style pairing.

naming.scope: MDN: text-underline-position

definition.zh: text-underline-position 选择下划线画在哪个位置（auto、under、left/right，配合竖排）。
definition.en: text-underline-position picks where the underline sits (auto, under, left/right for vertical text).

distinction.zh: 与 text-underline-offset 的区别：position 是策略位（含避让 descender），offset 是精确距离。
distinction.en: policy vs precise distance.

naming.scope: MDN: text-wrap-mode

definition.zh: text-wrap-mode 是换行基础开关（wrap/nowrap），text-wrap 速写的分项。
definition.en: text-wrap-mode is the base wrap switch (wrap/nowrap), a longhand of text-wrap.

distinction.zh: 与 white-space 的区别：nowrap 在 white-space 里也出现，text-wrap-mode 专门化换行语义。
distinction.en: the text-wrap slice of no-wrap behavior.

naming.scope: MDN: text-wrap-style

definition.zh: text-wrap-style 选择换行质量策略：wrap（默认）、balance（标题均衡断行）、pretty（避免孤词）、stable。
definition.en: text-wrap-style picks line-breaking quality: balance for headings, pretty to avoid orphans, stable.

distinction.zh: 与 text-wrap: balance 常用形式的区别：balance 是本属性的取值之一。
distinction.en: balance/pretty are values of this property.

naming.scope: MDN: timeline-trigger

definition.zh: timeline-trigger 在容器上声明触发器（名称、来源、激活区间），供 animation-trigger 引用。
definition.en: timeline-trigger declares a named trigger (source, ranges) that animation-trigger references.

distinction.zh: 与 scroll-timeline-name 的区别：timeline 提供进度，trigger 提供启停条件。
distinction.en: progress vs start/stop conditions.

naming.scope: MDN: timeline-trigger-activation-range

definition.zh: timeline-trigger-activation-range 定义触发器处于激活状态的时间线区间。
definition.en: timeline-trigger-activation-range defines when the trigger counts as active.

distinction.zh: 与 active-range 的区别：activation 是激活判定区间，active 是触发动作执行区间。
distinction.en: activation window vs action window.

naming.scope: MDN: timeline-trigger-activation-range-end

definition.zh: timeline-trigger-activation-range-end 设置触发器激活区间的终点位置，越过即退出激活态。
definition.en: the end edge of the activation range.

distinction.zh: 与起点分项的区别：一端进入激活、另一端离开激活，两值共同框出触发器的激活窗口。
distinction.en: pairs with the start longhand.

naming.scope: MDN: timeline-trigger-activation-range-start

definition.zh: timeline-trigger-activation-range-start 设置触发器激活区间的起点位置，进入即激活。
definition.en: the start edge of the activation range.

distinction.zh: 与终点分项的区别：start 是进入激活的边界，end 是退出激活的边界。
distinction.en: pairs with the end longhand.

naming.scope: MDN: timeline-trigger-active-range

definition.zh: timeline-trigger-active-range 定义触发器执行触发动作的时间线区间。
definition.en: the range in which the trigger fires its actions.

distinction.zh: 与 activation-range 的区别：激活是状态，active 是动作。
distinction.en: state window vs action window.

naming.scope: MDN: timeline-trigger-active-range-end
